title: The Book of Job Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Job — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.
verses.decoded: There was a man in the land of Uz named Job; this man was blameless and honest, respected God, and stayed away from evil.

verses.kjv: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
verses.decoded: He had seven sons and three daughters born to him.

verses.kjv: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.
verses.decoded: He also owned seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred pairs of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very large family; so this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

verses.kjv: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
verses.decoded: His sons went and had feasts in their own homes, each on his own day; and they sent for their three sisters to come and eat and drink with them.

verses.kjv: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
verses.decoded: When the days of their feasting were over, Job sent for them and made them holy, then got up early in the morning and offered burnt offerings for each of them, because Job said, "Maybe my sons have sinned and spoken against God in their hearts." Job did this regularly.

verses.kjv: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them.
verses.decoded: One day, the angels came to show themselves before the LORD, and Satan also came with them.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.decoded: The LORD asked Satan, Where have you come from? Satan answered the LORD, I have been roaming throughout the earth, walking back and forth on it.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?
verses.decoded: The LORD said to Satan, Have you noticed my servant Job? There is no one like him on earth, a perfect and honest man, one who respects God and avoids evil.

verses.kjv: Then Satan answered the Lord, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
verses.decoded: Then Satan answered the LORD and said, Does Job fear God for no reason?

verses.kjv: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
verses.decoded: Have you not made a protective barrier around him, and around his house, and around everything he owns on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his wealth has increased in the land.

verses.kjv: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.
verses.decoded: But reach out your hand now, and touch everything he has, and he will curse you to your face.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Satan, Look, everything he has is in your power; only do not lay a hand on him. So Satan left the presence of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:
verses.decoded: One day, his sons and daughters were eating and drinking wine at their oldest brother's house.

verses.kjv: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:
verses.decoded: A messenger came to Job and said, The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys were feeding beside them.

verses.kjv: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.decoded: And the Sabeans attacked them and took them away; yes, they killed the servants with the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.

verses.kjv: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.decoded: While he was still speaking, another person came and said, 'God's fire has fallen from heaven and burned up the sheep and the servants, and destroyed them; I alone have escaped to tell you.'

verses.kjv: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.decoded: While he was still speaking, another person came and said, The Chaldeans formed three groups, attacked the camels, took them away, and killed the servants with the sword; I alone have escaped to tell you.

verses.kjv: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:
verses.decoded: While he was still speaking, another person came and said, Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine at their oldest brother’s house.

verses.kjv: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.
verses.decoded: Suddenly, a strong wind came from the desert and struck the four corners of the house, causing it to collapse on the young men, and they died; I am the only one who escaped to tell you.

verses.kjv: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
verses.decoded: Then Job got up, tore his outer garment, shaved his head, fell to the ground, and worshiped,

verses.kjv: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: the Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And he said, I came out of my mother’s womb with nothing, and I will return there with nothing; the LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away; praise the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
verses.decoded: In all of this, Job did not sin or accuse God foolishly.

verses.kjv: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the Lord.
verses.decoded: Once again, there was a day when the angels came to stand before the LORD, and Satan also came with them to stand before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered the Lord, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to Satan, Where have you come from? Satan answered the LORD, I have been going back and forth on the earth, walking up and down on it.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.
verses.decoded: The LORD said to Satan, Have you thought about my servant Job? There is no one like him on earth, a perfect and honest man who respects God and avoids evil. Yet he still maintains his integrity, even though you encouraged me to harm him without reason.

verses.kjv: And Satan answered the Lord, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.
verses.decoded: And Satan answered the LORD and said, 'A person will give up everything they have to save their own life.'

verses.kjv: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.
verses.decoded: But reach out your hand now and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse you to your face.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Satan, Look, he is in your power; but do not kill him.

verses.kjv: So went Satan forth from the presence of the Lord, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
verses.decoded: So Satan left the presence of the LORD and struck Job with painful boils from the bottom of his foot to the top of his head.

verses.kjv: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
verses.decoded: And he took a broken piece of pottery to scrape himself with; and he sat down among the ashes.

verses.kjv: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.
verses.decoded: Then his wife said to him, Are you still holding on to your integrity? Curse God and die.

verses.kjv: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.
verses.decoded: But he said to her, You are speaking like one of the foolish women speaks. What? Should we accept good things from God, and not accept trouble? In all of this, Job did not sin by what he said.

verses.kjv: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.
verses.decoded: When Job’s three friends heard about all the troubles that had come to him, each of them came from their own home; Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamath. They had agreed to meet together to mourn with him and to comfort him.

verses.kjv: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.
verses.decoded: When they looked up from a distance and did not recognize him, they shouted loudly and cried; each one tore his outer garment and threw dust on his head toward the sky.

verses.kjv: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.
verses.decoded: So they sat with him on the ground for seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him because they saw that his suffering was very intense.

verses.kjv: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
verses.decoded: After this, Job spoke and cursed the day he was born.

verses.kjv: And Job spake, and said,
verses.decoded: And Job spoke and said,

verses.kjv: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.
verses.decoded: Let the day I was born be destroyed, and the night when it was said, 'A male child has been conceived.'

verses.kjv: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
verses.decoded: Let that day be dark; may God not look at it from heaven, and may no light shine on it.

verses.kjv: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.decoded: Let darkness and the shadow of death cover it; let a cloud stay over it; let the darkness of the day frighten it.

verses.kjv: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.decoded: As for that night, let darkness take control of it; do not include it among the days of the year, do not count it among the months.

verses.kjv: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.decoded: Look, let that night be alone, and let no happy voice be heard in it.

verses.kjv: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
verses.decoded: Let those who curse the day also curse it, those who are ready to express their sorrow.

verses.kjv: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
verses.decoded: Let the stars of that evening be dark; let it search for light, but find none; and do not let it see the sunrise.

verses.kjv: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.
verses.decoded: Because it did not close the doors of my mother’s womb, nor keep sorrow away from my eyes.

verses.kjv: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
verses.decoded: Why did I not die before I was born? Why did I not stop living as soon as I came out of the womb?

verses.kjv: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
verses.decoded: Why did my knees stop me? Or why did my mother's breasts exist for me to nurse?

verses.kjv: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
verses.decoded: If only I had died when I was still and quiet, I would have been asleep; then I would have been at peace.

verses.kjv: With kings and counsellers of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;
verses.decoded: With kings and advisors of the earth, who built deserted places for themselves;

verses.kjv: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
verses.decoded: Or with princes who had gold and filled their houses with silver:

verses.kjv: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
verses.decoded: Or like a hidden premature birth I had not existed; like babies who never saw the light.

verses.kjv: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
verses.decoded: There the wicked stop causing trouble; and there the tired are at peace.

verses.kjv: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
verses.decoded: There the prisoners rest together; they do not hear the voice of the oppressor.

verses.kjv: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.
verses.decoded: Both the lowly and the important are there; and the servant is no longer under the control of his master.

verses.kjv: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;
verses.decoded: Why is light given to someone who is suffering, and life given to someone who is bitter in soul?

verses.kjv: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
verses.decoded: Who long for death, but it does not come; and search for it more than for hidden treasures;

verses.kjv: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.decoded: Who are very happy and glad when they can find the grave?

verses.kjv: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?
verses.decoded: Why is light given to a person whose path is hidden, and whom God has surrounded with barriers?

verses.kjv: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
verses.decoded: Because I start sighing before I eat, and my loud cries flow out like water.

verses.kjv: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
verses.decoded: The thing I was very afraid of has happened to me, and what I feared has come to me.

verses.kjv: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
verses.decoded: I was not safe, I did not have rest, I was not calm; yet trouble still came.

verses.kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.decoded: Then Eliphaz from Teman answered and said,

verses.kjv: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.decoded: If we try to talk with you, will you be upset? But who can stop themselves from speaking?

verses.kjv: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.decoded: Look, you have taught many people, and you have made weak hands strong.

verses.kjv: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.decoded: Your words have supported the one who was about to fall, and you have made weak knees strong.

verses.kjv: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
verses.decoded: But now it has come to you, and you are weak; it affects you, and you are upset.

verses.kjv: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
verses.decoded: Is this not your reverence, your trust, your hope, and the integrity of your actions?

verses.kjv: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
verses.decoded: Remember, I ask you, has anyone ever died while being innocent? Or where have the righteous been completely destroyed?

verses.kjv: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
verses.decoded: Just as I have observed, those who plant wrongdoing and sow evil will harvest the same.

verses.kjv: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
verses.decoded: They die because of God's powerful wind, and they are destroyed by the breath from his nostrils.

verses.kjv: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.decoded: The roar of the lion, the sound of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions are all broken.

verses.kjv: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.
verses.decoded: The old lion dies because it has no food, and the strong lion’s cubs are spread out everywhere.

verses.kjv: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
verses.decoded: Now something was secretly brought to me, and my ear heard a little of it.

verses.kjv: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.decoded: In thoughts from the dreams of the night, when deep sleep comes upon people,

verses.kjv: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
verses.decoded: Fear came over me, and I was trembling, which made all my bones shake.

verses.kjv: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
verses.decoded: Then a spirit passed in front of me; the hair on my body stood up:

verses.kjv: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
verses.decoded: It stopped moving, but I could not make out its shape: a vision appeared before my eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice saying,

verses.kjv: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
verses.decoded: Can a human being be more righteous than God? Can a person be purer than the one who created him?

verses.kjv: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
verses.decoded: Look, he did not trust his servants; and he accused his angels of foolishness:

verses.kjv: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
verses.decoded: How much less in those who live in fragile bodies made of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, and who are destroyed even before the moth?

verses.kjv: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
verses.decoded: They are destroyed from morning to evening; they die forever without anyone paying attention.

verses.kjv: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
verses.decoded: Does not the honor that is within them disappear? They die, even without wisdom.

verses.kjv: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?
verses.decoded: Call now, if there is anyone who will answer you; and to which of the holy ones will you turn?

verses.kjv: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.decoded: Because anger kills the foolish person, and jealousy destroys the simple person.

verses.kjv: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.decoded: I have seen foolish people becoming established, but suddenly I cursed their homes.

verses.kjv: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
verses.decoded: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed at the city gate, and there is no one to rescue them.

verses.kjv: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
verses.decoded: The hungry eat their harvest and take it even from among the thorns, and the robber consumes their possessions.

verses.kjv: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.decoded: Even though suffering does not come from the dust, and trouble does not arise from the earth;

verses.kjv: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.decoded: But people are born to experience trouble, just like sparks fly upward.

verses.kjv: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:
verses.decoded: I would look to God, and I would entrust my case to God.

verses.kjv: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
verses.decoded: Who does great and unsearchable things; wonderful things beyond counting:

verses.kjv: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:
verses.decoded: Who gives rain to the earth and sends water to the fields:

verses.kjv: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
verses.decoded: To lift up those who are low; so that those who are grieving may be raised to safety.

verses.kjv: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
verses.decoded: He frustrates the plans of the clever, so that their hands cannot carry out their schemes.

verses.kjv: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
verses.decoded: He catches the wise people in their own clever plans, and the advice of the stubborn is thrown down quickly.

verses.kjv: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
verses.decoded: They encounter darkness during the day, and feel their way at noon as if it were night.

verses.kjv: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.decoded: But he saves the poor from the sword, from their own words, and from the power of the strong.

verses.kjv: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.decoded: So the poor have hope, and wrongdoing silences them.

verses.kjv: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:
verses.decoded: Look, happy is the person whom God corrects; so do not reject the discipline from the Almighty.

verses.kjv: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.decoded: Because he causes pain, and then heals it: he injures, and his hands heal completely.

verses.kjv: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.
verses.decoded: He will rescue you from six troubles; yes, in seven, no harm will come near you.

verses.kjv: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.decoded: During a famine, he will rescue you from death; and during war, he will save you from the power of the sword.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.
verses.decoded: You will be protected from harmful words; you will not be afraid of destruction when it comes.

verses.kjv: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.decoded: You will laugh during destruction and famine; you will not be afraid of the wild animals on the earth.

verses.kjv: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.
verses.decoded: Because you will be in agreement with the stones of the field, and the animals of the field will be at peace with you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.
verses.decoded: And you will know that your tent will be at peace; and you will go to your home and will not sin.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.decoded: You will also know that your descendants will be many, and your children will be as numerous as the grass of the earth.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.
verses.decoded: You will come to your grave at a full age, just as a bundle of grain comes in at its proper time.

verses.kjv: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.
verses.decoded: Look, we have examined it, and it is true; listen to it and understand it for your benefit.

verses.kjv: But Job answered and said,
verses.decoded: But Job replied and said,

verses.kjv: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!
verses.decoded: I wish my suffering could be fully measured and my disaster placed on the scales to be weighed together!

verses.kjv: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.
verses.decoded: Right now, it would be heavier than the sand of the sea; that is why my words are overwhelmed.

verses.kjv: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.
verses.decoded: Because the arrows of the Almighty are inside me, and their poison consumes my spirit; the terrors of God are lined up against me.

verses.kjv: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
verses.decoded: Does the wild donkey bray when it has grass? Or does the ox low over its food?

verses.kjv: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
verses.decoded: Can something that has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or does the white of an egg have any taste?

verses.kjv: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.
verses.decoded: The things that my soul refused to touch are like the food I eat when I am sad.

verses.kjv: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!
verses.decoded: I wish I could have what I ask for; and that God would give me what I desire!

verses.kjv: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
verses.decoded: I wish it would please God to destroy me; that he would release his hand and end my life!

verses.kjv: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
verses.decoded: Then I would still have comfort; yes, I would make myself strong in sorrow. Let him not show mercy; for I have not hidden the words of the Holy One.

verses.kjv: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?
verses.decoded: What strength do I have to keep hoping? And what is my purpose for wanting to live longer?

verses.kjv: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?
verses.decoded: Is my strength as strong as stones? Or is my body made of bronze?

verses.kjv: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
verses.decoded: Is my help not within me? Has wisdom completely left me?

verses.kjv: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
verses.decoded: Compassion should be shown to a person who is suffering by their friend; but that person abandons respect for the Almighty.

verses.kjv: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;
verses.decoded: My friends have acted deceitfully like a small stream, and like the flow of streams they disappear;

verses.kjv: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:
verses.decoded: They are dark because of the ice, and the snow is hidden within them.

verses.kjv: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.decoded: When they become warm, they disappear; when it gets hot, they are destroyed from their place.

verses.kjv: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
verses.decoded: The roads they follow are twisted; they lead to nothing and come to ruin.

verses.kjv: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
verses.decoded: The soldiers from Tema watched, the groups from Sheba waited for them.

verses.kjv: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
verses.decoded: They were confused because they had hoped; they came there and were ashamed.

verses.kjv: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.
verses.decoded: Because now you are nothing; you see my suffering and you are afraid.

verses.kjv: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
verses.decoded: Did I say, Bring something to me? Or, Give me a reward from your possessions?

verses.kjv: Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
verses.decoded: Or, save me from the enemy's power? Or, rescue me from the hand of the strong?

verses.kjv: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
verses.decoded: Teach me, and I will be silent; help me understand where I have made a mistake.

verses.kjv: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?
verses.decoded: How powerful are truthful words! But what does your argument prove?

verses.kjv: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
verses.decoded: Do you think you can correct words and the statements of someone who is desperate, which are like the wind?

verses.kjv: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.
verses.decoded: Yes, you oppress the fatherless, and you dig a pit to trap your friend.

verses.kjv: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.
verses.decoded: So now, be satisfied and look at me; it is clear to you if I am lying.

verses.kjv: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.
verses.decoded: Please come back, I ask you, may it not be wrongdoing; yes, come back again, my innocence is in it.

verses.kjv: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
verses.decoded: Is there sin in what I say? Can my sense of taste not recognize harmful things?
Is there not a set time for a person on earth? Are not his days also like the days of a hired worker?

verses.kjv: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:
verses.decoded: Just as a servant eagerly desires shade, and as a hired worker looks forward to the payment for his labor:

verses.kjv: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.decoded: I am given months filled with emptiness, and tiring nights are assigned to me.

verses.kjv: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
verses.decoded: When I lie down, I say, 'When will I get up, and the night be over?' and I keep tossing and turning until the morning comes.

verses.kjv: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
verses.decoded: My body is covered with worms and lumps of dust; my skin is damaged and has become disgusting.

verses.kjv: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
verses.decoded: My days pass faster than a weaver’s shuttle moves, and they end without any hope.

verses.kjv: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.
verses.decoded: Please remember that my life is like a breath: my eyes will no longer see anything good.

verses.kjv: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.
verses.decoded: The eyes of the person who has seen me will not see me again; your eyes are on me, but I no longer exist.

verses.kjv: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.
verses.decoded: Just as a cloud disappears and fades away, so the person who goes down to the grave will not come back up.

verses.kjv: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
verses.decoded: He will not return to his house again, and his place will no longer recognize him.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.decoded: So I will not hold back my mouth; I will speak because of the pain in my spirit; I will complain because of the bitterness in my soul.

verses.kjv: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?
verses.decoded: Am I like the sea, or a whale, that you place a guard over me?

verses.kjv: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
verses.decoded: When I say, My bed will give me comfort, my couch will relieve my suffering;

verses.kjv: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
verses.decoded: Then you frighten me with dreams, and you terrify me through visions:

verses.kjv: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.
verses.decoded: So that my soul prefers being strangled and death rather than living.

verses.kjv: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.
verses.decoded: I hate it; I do not want to live forever: leave me alone; because my days are meaningless.

verses.kjv: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?
verses.decoded: What is a human being that you should make him important? And why do you care so much about him?

verses.kjv: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?
verses.decoded: And that you would examine him every morning and test him every moment?

verses.kjv: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
verses.decoded: How long will you not leave me alone, nor let me be until I swallow my saliva?

verses.kjv: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?
verses.decoded: I have sinned; what can I do to you, O protector of people? Why have you made me a target against you, so that I am a burden to myself?

verses.kjv: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.
verses.decoded: And why do you not forgive my sin and remove my wrongdoing? Because now I will sleep in the dust, and you will look for me in the morning, but I will no longer be here.

verses.kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.decoded: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

verses.kjv: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?
verses.decoded: How long will you keep saying these things? And how long will the words from your mouth be like a strong wind?

verses.kjv: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.decoded: Does God twist judgment? Or does the Almighty twist justice?

verses.kjv: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
verses.decoded: If your children have sinned against him, and he has rejected them because of their wrongdoing;

verses.kjv: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;
verses.decoded: If you would seek God early, and make your prayer to the Almighty;

verses.kjv: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.
verses.decoded: If you were pure and honest, surely now he would act on your behalf and make the place where your righteousness lives successful.

verses.kjv: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
verses.decoded: Although your beginning was small, your later success will greatly increase.

verses.kjv: For inquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
verses.decoded: Please ask about the earlier times, and get ready to investigate the lives of their ancestors.

verses.kjv: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
verses.decoded: Because we have only existed since yesterday and know nothing, since our days on earth are like a shadow.

verses.kjv: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.decoded: Won't they teach you, and tell you, and speak words from their heart?

verses.kjv: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
verses.decoded: Can the rush grow without mud? Can the flag grow without water?

verses.kjv: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
verses.decoded: While it is still green and has not been cut down, it dries up before any other plant.

verses.kjv: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:
verses.decoded: This is true for everyone who forgets God; and the hope of a hypocrite will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.
verses.decoded: Their hope will be destroyed, and their confidence will be as fragile as a spider’s web.

verses.kjv: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
verses.decoded: He will depend on his house, but it will not remain standing; he will hold onto it tightly, but it will not last.

verses.kjv: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
verses.decoded: He is green before the sun rises, and his branch grows in his garden.

verses.kjv: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.
verses.decoded: Its roots are wrapped around the pile, and it sees the place of stones.

verses.kjv: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.
verses.decoded: If God removes him from his position, then that place will reject him, saying, I have not seen you.

verses.kjv: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
verses.decoded: Look, this is the happiness in his path, and others will grow from the earth.

verses.kjv: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
verses.decoded: Look, God will not reject a blameless person, and he will not support those who do evil.

verses.kjv: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.
verses.decoded: Until he fills your mouth with laughter, and your lips with joy.

verses.kjv: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
verses.decoded: Those who hate you will be covered with shame; and the home of the wicked will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
verses.decoded: Then Job replied and said,

verses.kjv: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
verses.decoded: I know that is true: but how can a person be right with God?

verses.kjv: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
verses.decoded: If someone tries to argue with God, they cannot give him an answer even one time out of a thousand.

verses.kjv: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
verses.decoded: He is wise in mind and powerful in strength: who has made themselves stubborn against him and succeeded?

verses.kjv: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
verses.decoded: He moves the mountains, and they do not realize it; he overturns them when he is angry.

verses.kjv: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
verses.decoded: Who shakes the earth out of its place, and its foundations tremble.

verses.kjv: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.
verses.decoded: Who commands the sun, and it does not rise; and closes the stars.

verses.kjv: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.
verses.decoded: He alone spreads out the heavens and walks on the waves of the sea.

verses.kjv: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
verses.decoded: Who creates Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the southern constellations.

verses.kjv: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
verses.decoded: Who does great things beyond understanding; yes, and wonders without number.

verses.kjv: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.
verses.decoded: Look, he goes past me, and I do not see him; he moves on as well, but I do not notice him.

verses.kjv: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.decoded: Look, he takes away; who can stop him? Who will say to him, What are you doing?

verses.kjv: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
verses.decoded: If God does not take back his anger, the proud supporters bow down beneath him.

verses.kjv: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
verses.decoded: How much less can I answer him and carefully choose my words to argue with him?

verses.kjv: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.decoded: Even if I were righteous, I would not answer him, but I would plead with my judge.

verses.kjv: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
verses.decoded: If I had called, and he had answered me; still I would not believe that he had listened to my voice.

verses.kjv: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
verses.decoded: Because he strikes me with a storm, and increases my wounds for no reason.

verses.kjv: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
verses.decoded: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

verses.kjv: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
verses.decoded: If I talk about strength, look, he is strong; and if I talk about justice, who will give me a time to argue my case?

verses.kjv: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
verses.decoded: If I declare myself innocent, my own words will accuse me; if I say, I am without fault, it will prove that I am wrong.

verses.kjv: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
verses.decoded: Even if I were perfect, I still would not understand my own soul; I would hate my own life.

verses.kjv: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.
verses.decoded: This is one thing, so I said it: He destroys both the innocent and the guilty.

verses.kjv: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
verses.decoded: If the punishment kills suddenly, he will mock the testing of the innocent.

verses.kjv: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?
verses.decoded: The earth is handed over to the wicked; he hides the faces of its judges. If he does not, then where is he, and who is he?

verses.kjv: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
verses.decoded: Now my days are faster than a messenger; they pass quickly, and they do not see any good.

verses.kjv: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.
verses.decoded: They pass away like fast ships, like an eagle that quickly goes after its prey.

verses.kjv: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:
verses.decoded: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will stop feeling sad, and try to comfort myself:

verses.kjv: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.
verses.decoded: I am afraid of all my troubles; I know that you will not declare me innocent.

verses.kjv: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?
verses.decoded: If I am wicked, then why do I work hard for nothing?

verses.kjv: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;
verses.decoded: If I wash myself with snow water and clean my hands as much as possible;

verses.kjv: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.
verses.decoded: But you will throw me into the pit, and even my own clothes will reject me.

verses.kjv: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.
verses.decoded: For he is not a man like me, so I cannot answer him or meet with him in court.

verses.kjv: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.
verses.decoded: There is no mediator between us who can put his hand on both of us.

verses.kjv: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:
verses.decoded: Let him remove his rod from me, and let his threat not frighten me.

verses.kjv: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.
verses.decoded: Then I would speak without being afraid of him; but that is not the case with me.

verses.kjv: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.decoded: I am tired of my life; I will keep my complaint to myself; I will express the bitterness in my soul.

verses.kjv: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.
verses.decoded: I will say to God, Do not accuse me; show me why you are arguing against me.

verses.kjv: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?
verses.decoded: Is it good for you to oppress, to despise the work of your hands, and to favor the plans of the wicked?

verses.kjv: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?
verses.decoded: Do you have eyes like a human? Or do you see things the way a person sees?

verses.kjv: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man’s days,
verses.decoded: Are your days like the days of a human? Are your years like the days of a man?

verses.kjv: That thou inquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?
verses.decoded: Are you investigating my wrongdoing and looking closely at my sin?

verses.kjv: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.
verses.decoded: You know that I am not wicked; and there is no one who can rescue me from your hand.

verses.kjv: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.
verses.decoded: Your hands made me and formed me completely; yet you destroy me.

verses.kjv: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?
verses.decoded: Please remember that you made me like clay; will you bring me back to dust again?

verses.kjv: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?
verses.decoded: Did you not pour me out like milk and curdle me like cheese?

verses.kjv: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.
verses.decoded: You have covered me with skin and flesh, and you have surrounded me with bones and muscles.

verses.kjv: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.
verses.decoded: You have given me life and kindness, and your attention has kept my spirit alive.

verses.kjv: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.
verses.decoded: And you have hidden these things in your heart: I know that this is with you.

verses.kjv: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.
verses.decoded: If I sin, then you notice me, and you will not clear me from my wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;
verses.decoded: If I am wicked, then I am doomed; and if I am righteous, I still will not raise my head. I am full of confusion; so please look at my suffering;

verses.kjv: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.
verses.decoded: Because it grows. You chase me like a fierce lion, and again you show yourself wonderfully against me.

verses.kjv: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.
verses.decoded: You bring up your accusations against me again, and you increase your anger toward me; troubles and conflict are against me.

verses.kjv: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!
verses.decoded: Why then did you bring me out of the womb? I wish I had died before being seen by anyone!

verses.kjv: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.
verses.decoded: I would have been as if I never existed; I would have been taken from the womb directly to the grave.

verses.kjv: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,
verses.decoded: Are my days not few? Then stop and leave me alone so that I can have a little comfort.

verses.kjv: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;
verses.decoded: Before I go to the place from which I will not come back, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

verses.kjv: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.
verses.decoded: A land of darkness, just like darkness itself; and a place covered by the shadow of death, without any structure, where the light is like darkness.

verses.kjv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.decoded: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,

verses.kjv: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?
verses.decoded: Shouldn't many words be answered? And should a man who talks a lot be considered right?

verses.kjv: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?
verses.decoded: Should your lies cause people to remain silent? And when you mock, will no one make you feel ashamed?

verses.kjv: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.
verses.decoded: Because you have said, 'My teaching is pure, and I am innocent in your eyes.'

verses.kjv: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;
verses.decoded: But I wish that God would speak and openly confront you;

verses.kjv: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.
verses.decoded: And that he would show you the secrets of wisdom, that they are twice as much as what is! So know that God demands less from you than your sin deserves.

verses.kjv: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?
verses.decoded: Can you, by searching, discover God? Can you fully understand the Almighty?

verses.kjv: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?
verses.decoded: It is as high as heaven; what can you do? deeper than hell; what can you know?

verses.kjv: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.
verses.decoded: Its extent is longer than the earth and wider than the sea.

verses.kjv: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?
verses.decoded: If he stops something, locks it away, or brings it all together, then who can stop him?

verses.kjv: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?
verses.decoded: Because he knows empty people; he also sees wickedness; will he not then think about it?

verses.kjv: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass’s colt.
verses.decoded: Because foolish people want to be wise, even though they are born like wild donkey foals.

verses.kjv: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;
verses.decoded: If you prepare your heart and reach out your hands to him;

verses.kjv: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.
verses.decoded: If sin is in your hand, put it far away, and do not let evil live in your dwelling places.

verses.kjv: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:
verses.decoded: Because then you will lift up your face without any blemish; yes, you will be firm and will not be afraid.

verses.kjv: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:
verses.decoded: Because you will forget your suffering and remember it like water that flows away:

verses.kjv: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.
verses.decoded: And your life will be brighter than midday; you will shine brightly, you will be like the morning.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.
verses.decoded: And you will be safe because there is hope; yes, you will dig around yourself, and you will rest in safety.

verses.kjv: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.
verses.decoded: You will lie down, and no one will make you afraid; yes, many will ask you for help.

verses.kjv: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.
verses.decoded: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, and they will not escape, and their hope will be like the last breath.

verses.kjv: And Job answered and said,
verses.decoded: Then Job replied and said,

verses.kjv: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.
verses.decoded: There is no doubt that you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

verses.kjv: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?
verses.decoded: But I have understanding just like you; I am not less than you. In fact, who does not know things like these?

verses.kjv: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.
verses.decoded: I am like someone mocked by their neighbor, who calls on God and God answers them: the righteous and honest person is laughed at.

verses.kjv: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.
verses.decoded: The person who is about to stumble with their feet is like a lamp that is looked down upon by someone who is comfortable.

verses.kjv: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.
verses.decoded: The homes of robbers succeed, and those who anger God feel safe; God gives them plenty.

verses.kjv: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:
verses.decoded: But now ask the animals, and they will teach you; and the birds of the air, and they will tell you:

verses.kjv: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.
verses.decoded: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you; and the fish of the sea will tell you.

verses.kjv: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the Lord hath wrought this?
verses.decoded: Who does not know from all of this that the hand of the LORD has done this?

verses.kjv: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.
verses.decoded: The soul of every living thing and the breath of all people are in his hand.

verses.kjv: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?
verses.decoded: Does not the ear test words? And does not the mouth taste its food?

verses.kjv: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.
verses.decoded: Wisdom is with the elderly, and understanding comes with many years of life.

verses.kjv: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.
verses.decoded: With him is wisdom and strength; he has advice and understanding.

verses.kjv: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.
verses.decoded: Look, he destroys something, and it cannot be rebuilt; he locks a person up, and there is no way to get out.

verses.kjv: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.
verses.decoded: Look, he stops the waters, and they dry up; he also sends them out, and they flood the earth.

verses.kjv: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.
verses.decoded: He has strength and wisdom; both the one who is deceived and the one who deceives belong to him.

verses.kjv: He leadeth counsellers away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.
verses.decoded: He takes counselors away defeated, and makes judges act foolishly.

verses.kjv: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.
verses.decoded: He removes the chains from kings and ties a belt around their waists.

verses.kjv: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.
verses.decoded: He takes princes away as captives, and he overthrows the powerful.

verses.kjv: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.
verses.decoded: He takes away the ability to speak from the reliable, and removes the understanding from the elderly.

verses.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.
verses.decoded: He causes princes to be despised and weakens the strength of the powerful.

verses.kjv: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.
verses.decoded: He reveals deep things from darkness and brings the shadow of death into the light.

verses.kjv: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.
verses.decoded: He makes nations grow and then destroys them; he expands nations and then restricts them again.

verses.kjv: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.
verses.decoded: He removes the courage of the leaders of the people on earth and makes them wander in a wilderness where there is no path.

verses.kjv: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.
verses.decoded: They feel around in the dark without any light, and he causes them to stagger like a drunk person.

verses.kjv: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
verses.decoded: Look, my eye has seen all of this, my ear has heard and understood it.

verses.kjv: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
verses.decoded: What you know, I also know: I am not less than you.

verses.kjv: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
verses.decoded: I definitely want to speak to the Almighty, and I want to argue my case with God.

verses.kjv: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
verses.decoded: But you are makers of lies, you are all useless doctors.

verses.kjv: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
verses.decoded: I wish you would all keep silent! That would be wise for you.

verses.kjv: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.decoded: Listen now to my argument, and pay attention to what I am saying.

verses.kjv: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
verses.decoded: Will you speak evil on behalf of God? And lie for him?

verses.kjv: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
verses.decoded: Will you show partiality to him? Will you argue on behalf of God?

verses.kjv: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
verses.decoded: Is it right for him to investigate you? Or do you mock him just as one person mocks another?

verses.kjv: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
verses.decoded: He will definitely correct you if you show favoritism in secret.

verses.kjv: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
verses.decoded: Will his greatness not make you afraid? Will his power not cause you to be filled with fear?

verses.kjv: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
verses.decoded: Your memories are like ashes, your bodies are like bodies made of clay.

verses.kjv: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
verses.decoded: Be quiet, leave me alone so I can speak, and let whatever will happen come upon me.

verses.kjv: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
verses.decoded: Why should I risk my own body and put my life in my own hands?

verses.kjv: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
verses.decoded: Even if he kills me, I will still trust in him; but I will defend my own ways in his presence.

verses.kjv: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
verses.decoded: He will also be my salvation, because a hypocrite will not stand in his presence.

verses.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully to what I say, and pay close attention to my explanation.

verses.kjv: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
verses.decoded: Look now, I have prepared my case; I know that I will be declared innocent.

verses.kjv: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
verses.decoded: Who will argue with me? Because now, if I remain silent, I will die.

verses.kjv: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
verses.decoded: Just do not do two things to me: then I will not hide myself from you.

verses.kjv: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
verses.decoded: Take your hand away from me, and do not let your terror scare me.

verses.kjv: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
verses.decoded: Then you call, and I will answer; or let me speak, and you answer me.

verses.kjv: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.decoded: How many sins and wrongdoings do I have? Help me understand my offenses and my sins.

verses.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
verses.decoded: Why do you hide your face and treat me like your enemy?

verses.kjv: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
verses.decoded: Will you break a leaf that is blown back and forth? And will you chase after dry stubble?

verses.kjv: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
verses.decoded: Because you write harsh things against me and make me carry the sins of my youth.

verses.kjv: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
verses.decoded: You also put my feet in the stocks and watch closely all my ways; you mark the steps of my feet.

verses.kjv: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
verses.decoded: And he destroys like something rotten, like a garment that has been eaten by moths.

verses.kjv: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
verses.decoded: A person born from a woman lives only a short time and is full of difficulties.

verses.kjv: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.
verses.decoded: He comes out like a flower and is cut down; he also passes away like a shadow and does not last.

verses.kjv: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?
verses.decoded: Do you open your eyes on someone like this and bring me into judgment with you?

verses.kjv: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.
verses.decoded: Who can produce something pure from something impure? No one.

verses.kjv: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;
verses.decoded: Since his days are decided, and the number of his months is with you, you have set limits that he cannot go beyond;

verses.kjv: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.
verses.decoded: Turn away from him so that he may rest until he finishes his work, like a hired worker finishes his day.

verses.kjv: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
verses.decoded: There is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will grow again, and its young branch will not stop growing.

verses.kjv: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;
verses.decoded: Even if its root grows old in the soil, and its trunk dies in the ground;

verses.kjv: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.
verses.decoded: But when it smells water, it will sprout and grow branches like a plant.

verses.kjv: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?
verses.decoded: But a person dies and decays; yes, a person breathes their last, and where are they?

verses.kjv: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:
verses.decoded: Just as the waters disappear from the sea, and the flood decreases and dries up:

verses.kjv: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.
verses.decoded: So a person lies down and does not get up; until the heavens are gone, they will not wake up or be raised from their sleep.

verses.kjv: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!
verses.decoded: Oh, that you would hide me in the grave, that you would keep me safe and secret until your anger has passed, that you would set a specific time for me and remember me!

verses.kjv: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.
verses.decoded: If a person dies, will they live again? I will wait all the days of my set time until my transformation happens.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.
verses.decoded: You will call, and I will answer you; you will long for the work of your hands.

verses.kjv: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?
verses.decoded: Right now you count every step I take; don't you keep an eye on my sins?

verses.kjv: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.
verses.decoded: My sin is sealed up in a bag, and you sew up my wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.
verses.decoded: And certainly the mountain falling becomes nothing, and the rock is taken away from its place.

verses.kjv: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.
verses.decoded: The waters erode the stones; you wash away the things that grow from the dust of the earth; and you destroy the hope of humans.

verses.kjv: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.
verses.decoded: You always have power over him, and he dies; you change his appearance and send him away.

verses.kjv: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.
verses.decoded: His sons become honored, and he does not know it; and they are brought low, but he does not realize it.

verses.kjv: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
verses.decoded: But his body will experience pain, and his inner being will grieve.

verses.kjv: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,
verses.decoded: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

verses.kjv: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?
verses.decoded: Should a wise man speak worthless knowledge and fill himself with empty words?

verses.kjv: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?
verses.decoded: Should he argue using useless words? Or with speeches that cannot help anyone?

verses.kjv: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.
verses.decoded: Yes, you reject fear and hold back prayer before God.

verses.kjv: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.
verses.decoded: Because your mouth speaks your wrongdoing, and you choose to use the words of a deceitful person.

verses.kjv: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.
verses.decoded: Your own mouth condemns you, not me; yes, your own lips testify against you.

verses.kjv: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?
verses.decoded: Are you the first person ever born? Or were you created before the hills?

verses.kjv: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?
verses.decoded: Have you heard God's secret? And are you keeping wisdom only to yourself?

verses.kjv: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?
verses.decoded: What do you know that we do not know? What do you understand that is not in us?

verses.kjv: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
verses.decoded: Among us are both the gray-haired and very old men, much older than your father.

verses.kjv: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?
verses.decoded: Are God's comforts insignificant to you? Do you have any hidden secrets?

verses.kjv: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,
verses.decoded: Why does your heart lead you astray? And what are your eyes looking at with a secret glance?

verses.kjv: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?
verses.decoded: That you turn your spirit against God, and allow such words to come out of your mouth?

verses.kjv: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
verses.decoded: What is a person that they should be pure? And someone born of a woman, that they should be righteous?

verses.kjv: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
verses.decoded: Look, he does not trust his holy ones; yes, even the heavens are not pure in his eyes.

verses.kjv: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?
verses.decoded: How much more disgusting and dirty is a person who takes in sin as easily as they drink water?

verses.kjv: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;
verses.decoded: I will show you, listen to me; and what I have seen I will explain;

verses.kjv: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:
verses.decoded: Wise men have passed down this knowledge from their fathers and have not kept it secret.

verses.kjv: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.
verses.decoded: To whom the earth was given alone, and no foreigner passed among them.

verses.kjv: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.
verses.decoded: The wicked man works hard with pain every day of his life, and the length of his life is unknown to the oppressor.

verses.kjv: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.
verses.decoded: A terrible noise is in his ears: when he is successful, the destroyer will come to him.

verses.kjv: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.
verses.decoded: He does not believe that he will come back from darkness, and the sword is waiting for him.

verses.kjv: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.
verses.decoded: He goes around looking for bread, asking, Where is it? He knows that the day of trouble is near.

verses.kjv: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
verses.decoded: Trouble and distress will make him afraid; they will overcome him like a king prepared for battle.

verses.kjv: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.
verses.decoded: Because he reaches out his hand against God and makes himself strong against the Almighty.

verses.kjv: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:
verses.decoded: He charges at him, right on his neck, against the thick central parts of his shields.

verses.kjv: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.
verses.decoded: Because he covers his face with his fatness and makes thick pieces of fat on his sides.

verses.kjv: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.
verses.decoded: And he lives in empty cities, and in houses that no one lives in, which are about to fall into ruins.

verses.kjv: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.
verses.decoded: He will not become rich, nor will his wealth last, nor will he extend his prosperity on the earth.

verses.kjv: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.
verses.decoded: He will not come out of darkness; the fire will dry up his branches, and he will disappear by the breath of his mouth.

verses.kjv: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.
verses.decoded: Do not let the person who is deceived trust in emptiness, because emptiness will be their reward.

verses.kjv: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.
verses.decoded: It will happen before its time, and his branch will not be fresh and green.

verses.kjv: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.
verses.decoded: He will shake off his unripe grapes like a vine, and will drop his blossoms like an olive tree.

verses.kjv: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.
verses.decoded: Because the group of hypocrites will be destroyed, and fire will burn down the places built through bribery.

verses.kjv: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.
verses.decoded: They plan evil, and produce worthless things, and their stomach prepares lies.

verses.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
verses.decoded: Then Job replied and said,

verses.kjv: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
verses.decoded: I have heard many things like this: you are all terrible at comforting.

verses.kjv: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
verses.decoded: Will meaningless words ever stop? Or what gives you the confidence to answer?

verses.kjv: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
verses.decoded: I could also speak like you do: if your soul were in my place, I could pile up words against you and shake my head at you.

verses.kjv: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
verses.decoded: But I would encourage you with my words, and the movement of my lips would ease your pain.

verses.kjv: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.decoded: Even when I speak, my pain is not relieved; and even when I hold back, how am I comforted?

verses.kjv: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
