verses.decoded: But now he has made me tired; you have left all my friends alone and abandoned.

verses.kjv: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
verses.decoded: And you have covered me with wrinkles, which serve as evidence against me; and my thinness that shows in me testifies to my face.

verses.kjv: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
verses.decoded: He tears me apart in his anger, the one who hates me; he grinds his teeth at me; my enemy stares at me intently.

verses.kjv: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
verses.decoded: They have stared at me with their mouths open; they have struck me on the cheek in insult; they have come together against me.

verses.kjv: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
verses.decoded: God has handed me over to the godless and turned me into the hands of the wicked.

verses.kjv: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
verses.decoded: I was comfortable, but he has torn me apart: he has also grabbed me by my neck, shaken me violently, and set me up as his target.

verses.kjv: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
verses.decoded: His archers surround me completely, he cuts open my kidneys and does not show mercy; he pours out my bitterness on the ground.

verses.kjv: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
verses.decoded: He breaks me with one wound after another, he attacks me like a giant.

verses.kjv: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
verses.decoded: I have put on sackcloth over my skin, and I have humbled myself in the dust.

verses.kjv: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;
verses.decoded: My face is ugly from crying, and my eyelids are like the shadow of death;

verses.kjv: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
verses.decoded: Not because of any wrongdoing in my hands; my prayer is also pure.

verses.kjv: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
verses.decoded: O earth, do not cover my blood, and do not silence my cry.

verses.kjv: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
verses.decoded: Even now, look, my witness is in heaven, and my record is in the heights.

verses.kjv: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.
verses.decoded: My friends mock me, but my eyes pour out tears to God.

verses.kjv: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!
verses.decoded: I wish someone would argue on behalf of a person with God, just as a person argues for their neighbor!

verses.kjv: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
verses.decoded: When a few years have passed, then I will go the way from which I will not come back.

verses.kjv: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.
verses.decoded: My breath is weak, my days are ending, the graves are prepared for me.

verses.kjv: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?
verses.decoded: Are there not people mocking me? And does not my eye keep looking at their insults?

verses.kjv: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?
verses.decoded: Please guarantee my safety now; who will agree to be responsible with me?

verses.kjv: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.
verses.decoded: Because you have hidden their heart from understanding, you will not lift them up.

verses.kjv: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.
verses.decoded: The person who flatters his friends will cause even the eyes of his children to lose their strength.

verses.kjv: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.
verses.decoded: He has also made me a joke among the people; and in the past I was like a drum.

verses.kjv: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.
verses.decoded: My eye is also dim because of sadness, and all my limbs are like a shadow.

verses.kjv: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.
verses.decoded: Honest people will be shocked by this, and the innocent will stand up against the hypocrite.

verses.kjv: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.
verses.decoded: The righteous will also continue on their path, and the one who has clean hands will become stronger and stronger.

verses.kjv: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.
verses.decoded: But as for all of you, go back and come now, because I cannot find one wise person among you.

verses.kjv: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.
verses.decoded: My days are over, my plans are ended, even the thoughts in my heart.

verses.kjv: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.
verses.decoded: They turn the night into day: the light is brief because of the darkness.

verses.kjv: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.
verses.decoded: If I wait, the grave will be my home; I have prepared my bed in the darkness.

verses.kjv: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.
verses.decoded: I have said to decay, You are my father; to the worm, You are my mother and my sister.

verses.kjv: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?
verses.decoded: And where is my hope now? As for my hope, who will see it?

verses.kjv: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.
verses.decoded: They will go down to the prison bars of the grave, when our resting place together is in the dust.

verses.kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.decoded: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

verses.kjv: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.
verses.decoded: How long will you keep talking? Pay attention, and then we will speak.

verses.kjv: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?
verses.decoded: Why are we considered like animals and seen as worthless in your eyes?

verses.kjv: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?
verses.decoded: He tears himself apart in his anger: will the earth be abandoned because of you? And will the rock be moved from its place?

verses.kjv: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.
verses.decoded: Yes, the light of the wicked will be extinguished, and the spark of his fire will not shine.

verses.kjv: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.
verses.decoded: The light will be dark in his home, and his candle will be extinguished with him.

verses.kjv: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.
verses.decoded: The path of his strength will be limited, and his own advice will cause him to fall.

verses.kjv: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.
verses.decoded: Because he is caught in a trap by his own feet, and he walks into a snare.

verses.kjv: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.
verses.decoded: The trap will catch him by the heel, and the thief will overpower him.

verses.kjv: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.
verses.decoded: A trap is set for him on the ground, and a snare is placed for him along the path.

verses.kjv: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.
verses.decoded: Fears will scare him from all directions and force him to stand up.

verses.kjv: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.
verses.decoded: His strength will be weakened by hunger, and destruction will be waiting beside him.

verses.kjv: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.
verses.decoded: It will consume the strength of his body; even the earliest form of death will consume his strength.

verses.kjv: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.
verses.decoded: His confidence will be removed from his dwelling, and it will lead him to the ruler of fear.

verses.kjv: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.
verses.decoded: It will live in his home, even though it does not belong to him; sulfur will be scattered over his dwelling place.

verses.kjv: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.
verses.decoded: His roots will dry up below, and his branch will be cut off above.

verses.kjv: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.
verses.decoded: People will forget him completely, and no one will remember his name in the town.

verses.kjv: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.
verses.decoded: He will be forced away from the light into darkness, and expelled from the world.

verses.kjv: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.
verses.decoded: He will have neither son nor nephew among his people, nor anyone left living in his home.

verses.kjv: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.
verses.decoded: Those who come after him will be shocked on his day, just as those who came before were terrified.

verses.kjv: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.
verses.decoded: Certainly, these are the homes of the wicked, and this is the place of the one who does not know God.

verses.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
verses.decoded: Then Job replied and said,

verses.kjv: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?
verses.decoded: How long will you torment my soul and crush me with your words?

verses.kjv: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.
verses.decoded: You have insulted me ten times; you are not ashamed that you act like strangers to me.

verses.kjv: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.
verses.decoded: Even if I have made a mistake, my mistake stays with me.

verses.kjv: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:
verses.decoded: If you truly want to make yourselves greater than me and argue against me about my disgrace:

verses.kjv: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.
verses.decoded: Now understand that God has defeated me and surrounded me with his trap.

verses.kjv: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.
verses.decoded: Look, I cry out because of injustice, but no one listens to me; I shout loudly, but there is no justice.

verses.kjv: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
verses.decoded: He has blocked my way so that I cannot go through, and he has placed darkness on my paths.

verses.kjv: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
verses.decoded: He has taken away my honor and removed the crown from my head.

verses.kjv: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.
verses.decoded: He has destroyed me from every direction, and I am ruined; he has taken away my hope like a tree being uprooted.

verses.kjv: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.
verses.decoded: He has also stirred up his anger against me, and he considers me one of his enemies.

verses.kjv: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.
verses.decoded: His soldiers gather and block the road against me, and camp all around my tent.

verses.kjv: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.
verses.decoded: He has put my brothers far away from me, and my friends are truly distant from me.

verses.kjv: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.
verses.decoded: My relatives have abandoned me, and my close friends have forgotten about me.

verses.kjv: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.
verses.decoded: Those who live in my house, and my female servants, consider me a stranger; I am like a foreigner to them.

verses.kjv: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.
verses.decoded: I called my servant, but he did not answer me; I begged him with my words.

verses.kjv: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children’s sake of mine own body.
verses.decoded: My breathing is unfamiliar to my wife, even though I pleaded for the sake of my own children.

verses.kjv: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.
verses.decoded: Yes, even young children looked down on me; when I got up, they spoke against me.

verses.kjv: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.
verses.decoded: All my close friends hated me, and those I loved have turned against me.

verses.kjv: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.
verses.decoded: My bones stick to my skin and flesh, and I have barely escaped with the skin of my teeth.

verses.kjv: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.
verses.decoded: Have pity on me, have pity on me, O my friends; because the hand of God has touched me.

verses.kjv: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
verses.decoded: Why do you treat me like God and are not satisfied with my body?

verses.kjv: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!
verses.decoded: I wish my words were written down now! I wish they were printed in a book!

verses.kjv: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!
verses.decoded: That they were engraved with an iron pen and lead on the rock forever!

verses.kjv: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:
verses.decoded: I know that my redeemer is alive, and that he will stand on the earth in the last days.

verses.kjv: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:
verses.decoded: And even though worms destroy this body after my skin, I will still see God in my own flesh.

verses.kjv: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.
verses.decoded: Whom I will see with my own eyes, and my eyes will look at, not someone else's; even though my inner parts are destroyed within me.

verses.kjv: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?
verses.decoded: But you should say, Why do we persecute him, since the cause of the problem is found in me?

verses.kjv: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.
verses.decoded: Be afraid of the sword, because anger causes the punishments of the sword, so that you may understand that there is a judgment.

verses.kjv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.decoded: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said,

verses.kjv: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
verses.decoded: So my thoughts make me respond, and because of this I hurry to speak.

verses.kjv: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
verses.decoded: I have heard the rebuke of my insult, and my understanding makes me respond.

verses.kjv: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
verses.decoded: Do you not know this from long ago, since man was placed on the earth,

verses.kjv: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
verses.decoded: Is the success of the wicked only temporary, and the happiness of the hypocrite lasts only for a short time?

verses.kjv: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.decoded: Even if his greatness rises to the heavens, and his head reaches the clouds;

verses.kjv: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
verses.decoded: But he will be destroyed forever like his own waste; those who saw him will ask, 'Where is he?'

verses.kjv: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.decoded: He will disappear quickly like a dream and will not be found; yes, he will be driven away like a vision in the night.

verses.kjv: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.decoded: The eye that saw him will not see him again; his place will no longer watch over him.

verses.kjv: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
verses.decoded: His children will try to help the poor, and his hands will return what they have taken.

verses.kjv: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.decoded: His bones are filled with the guilt of his youth, which will rest with him in the dust.

verses.kjv: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
verses.decoded: Even if wickedness tastes sweet in his mouth, even if he keeps it hidden under his tongue;

verses.kjv: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
verses.decoded: Even if he spares it and does not give it up, but keeps it still in his mouth:

verses.kjv: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
verses.decoded: But the food in his stomach turns sour; it becomes the poison of snakes inside him.

verses.kjv: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.decoded: He has swallowed down wealth, and he will vomit it up again: God will force it out of his stomach.

verses.kjv: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.
verses.decoded: He will suck the poison of snakes; the viper’s tongue will kill him.

verses.kjv: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
verses.decoded: He will not see the rivers, the floods, or the streams of honey and butter.

verses.kjv: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
verses.decoded: He will have to give back what he worked for and will not keep it; the repayment will match what he has, and he will not be happy about it.

verses.kjv: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
verses.decoded: Because he has oppressed and abandoned the poor; because he has violently taken away a house he did not build;

verses.kjv: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
verses.decoded: Certainly, he will not have peace in his stomach, and he will not keep anything he wanted.

verses.kjv: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
verses.decoded: None of his food will remain; therefore, no one will expect to receive his possessions.

verses.kjv: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
verses.decoded: When he has plenty, trouble will come to him; every power of the wicked will attack him.

verses.kjv: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
verses.decoded: When he is about to fill his stomach, God will pour out the fury of His anger on him and will send it down on him while he is eating.

verses.kjv: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
verses.decoded: He will run away from the iron weapon, but the steel bow will pierce him.

verses.kjv: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
verses.decoded: It is pulled out and comes out of the body; yes, the shining sword comes out of his bitterness: fear is on him.

verses.kjv: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
verses.decoded: Complete darkness will be hidden in his secret places; a fire that is not fanned will burn him up; trouble will come to anyone left in his home.

verses.kjv: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.decoded: The sky will show his wrongdoing; and the earth will stand against him.

verses.kjv: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.decoded: The growth of his household will disappear, and his possessions will be gone on the day of his anger.

verses.kjv: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
verses.decoded: This is the share of a wicked man from God, and the inheritance assigned to him by God.

verses.kjv: But Job answered and said,
verses.decoded: But Job replied and said,

verses.kjv: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully to what I say, and let this be your comfort.

verses.kjv: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.
verses.decoded: Allow me to speak; and after I have spoken, continue to mock.

verses.kjv: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?
verses.decoded: As for me, is my complaint directed to people? And if that is the case, why shouldn't my spirit be disturbed?

verses.kjv: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.
verses.decoded: Pay attention to me, be amazed, and put your hand over your mouth.

verses.kjv: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.
verses.decoded: Even when I remember, I am afraid, and trembling grabs hold of my body.

verses.kjv: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?
verses.decoded: Why do the wicked live, grow old, and become powerful?

verses.kjv: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.
verses.decoded: Their children are secure in their presence, and their descendants are right in front of them.

verses.kjv: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.
verses.decoded: Their homes are free from fear, and God's punishment is not on them.

verses.kjv: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.
verses.decoded: Their bull mates and does not fail; their cow gives birth and does not lose her calf.

verses.kjv: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.
verses.decoded: They send out their young children like a flock, and their children dance.

verses.kjv: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
verses.decoded: They play the tambourine and harp, and celebrate to the music of the pipe.

verses.kjv: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.
verses.decoded: They live their lives in wealth, and suddenly they die and go to the grave.

verses.kjv: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.
verses.decoded: Therefore they say to God, Leave us alone; because we do not want to know your ways.

verses.kjv: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?
verses.decoded: Who is the Almighty that we should serve him? And what benefit will we get if we pray to him?

verses.kjv: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.decoded: Look, their prosperity is not in their control; the advice of the wicked is far from me.

verses.kjv: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.
verses.decoded: How often is the life of the wicked extinguished! And how often does their destruction come upon them! God gives sorrows in his anger.

verses.kjv: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.
verses.decoded: They are like dry straw blown by the wind, and like light chaff carried away by the storm.

verses.kjv: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.
verses.decoded: God stores up his wrongdoing for his children; He gives him what he deserves, and he will understand it.

verses.kjv: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.
verses.decoded: He will see his own destruction with his eyes, and he will experience the anger of the Almighty.

verses.kjv: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?
verses.decoded: What enjoyment does he have in his house after he is gone, when his life is cut short in the middle of his days?

verses.kjv: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
verses.decoded: Can anyone teach God anything? He is the one who judges those in high positions.

verses.kjv: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.
verses.decoded: Someone dies while still strong, completely comfortable and peaceful.

verses.kjv: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.
verses.decoded: His chest is full of milk, and his bones are filled with marrow.

verses.kjv: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.
verses.decoded: And another dies with a bitter soul, and never eats with enjoyment.

verses.kjv: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.
verses.decoded: They will all lie down together in the dust, and worms will cover them.

verses.kjv: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.
verses.decoded: Look, I know your thoughts and the plans you wrongly think up against me.

verses.kjv: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?
verses.decoded: Because you ask, 'Where is the house of the leader? And where are the homes of the wicked?'

verses.kjv: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,
verses.decoded: Have you not asked those who travel the road? And do you not recognize their signs?

verses.kjv: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.
verses.decoded: Is the wicked person kept for the day of destruction? They will be brought out on the day of anger.

verses.kjv: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?
verses.decoded: Who will explain his actions directly to him? And who will give him back what he has done?

verses.kjv: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
verses.decoded: Still, he will be taken to the grave and will stay in the tomb.

verses.kjv: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.
verses.decoded: The soil of the valley will be pleasant to him, and everyone will follow him, just as there are countless people ahead of him.

verses.kjv: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
verses.decoded: So why do you try to comfort me for no reason, when your answers are full of lies?

verses.kjv: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.decoded: Then Eliphaz from Teman answered and said,

verses.kjv: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?
verses.decoded: Can a person be helpful to God, just as a wise person can be helpful to themselves?

verses.kjv: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?
verses.decoded: Does the Almighty take any pleasure in your being righteous? Or does he benefit when you make your ways perfect?

verses.kjv: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?
verses.decoded: Will he correct you because he is afraid of you? Will he go into court with you to argue?

verses.kjv: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?
verses.decoded: Is your wickedness not great? And are your sins not endless?

verses.kjv: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
verses.decoded: For you have taken a pledge from your brother without cause, and you have taken the clothing off those who are naked.

verses.kjv: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.
verses.decoded: You have not given water to the tired to drink, and you have kept bread from the hungry.

verses.kjv: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.
verses.decoded: But the powerful man owned the land, and the respected man lived there.

verses.kjv: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
verses.decoded: You have sent widows away without anything, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.kjv: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;
verses.decoded: Therefore traps are all around you, and sudden fear troubles you;

verses.kjv: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.
verses.decoded: Or darkness that you cannot see; and a flood of waters covers you.

verses.kjv: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!
verses.decoded: Is God not in the highest part of heaven? And look at the height of the stars, how high they are!

verses.kjv: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?
verses.decoded: And you say, How does God know? Can he judge through the dark cloud?

verses.kjv: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.
verses.decoded: Thick clouds cover him so that he cannot see; and he moves around in the expanse of heaven.

verses.kjv: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?
verses.decoded: Have you noticed the ancient path that wicked people have walked on?

verses.kjv: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:
verses.decoded: They were destroyed before their time, and their foundation was washed away by a flood.

verses.kjv: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?
verses.decoded: Who said to God, 'Go away from us,' and what can the Almighty do for them?

verses.kjv: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
verses.decoded: Still, he filled their houses with good things, but the advice of the wicked is far from me.

verses.kjv: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.
verses.decoded: The righteous see it and are happy; the innocent mock them.

verses.kjv: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.
verses.decoded: While our wealth is not destroyed, the remainder of it is consumed by fire.

verses.kjv: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.
verses.decoded: Get to know him now, and be at peace; through this, good will come to you.

verses.kjv: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.
verses.decoded: Accept, I ask you, the law from his mouth, and store his words in your heart.

verses.kjv: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.
verses.decoded: If you return to the Almighty, you will be restored, and you will remove sin far from your dwelling places.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.
verses.decoded: Then you will store up gold like dust, and the gold from Ophir like the stones by the streams.

verses.kjv: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.
verses.decoded: Yes, the Almighty will be your protection, and you will have plenty of silver.

verses.kjv: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.
verses.decoded: Because then you will find joy in the Almighty, and you will look up to God.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.
verses.decoded: You will pray to him, and he will listen to you, and you will fulfill your promises.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.
verses.decoded: You will also decide on something, and it will be established for you; and light will shine on your paths.

verses.kjv: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.
verses.decoded: When people are discouraged, then you will say, There is hope; and he will save the humble person.

verses.kjv: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.
verses.decoded: He will rescue the innocent land, and it is saved by the purity of your hands.

verses.kjv: Then Job answered and said,
verses.decoded: Then Job replied and said,

verses.kjv: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.
verses.decoded: Even today my complaint is bitter: my suffering is worse than my groaning.

verses.kjv: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!
verses.decoded: I wish I knew where I could find him! So that I could come right to his presence!

verses.kjv: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
verses.decoded: I would present my case before him and speak all my reasons.

verses.kjv: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.
verses.decoded: I want to know the words he would use to answer me, and understand what he would say to me.

verses.kjv: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.
verses.decoded: Will God argue against me with his great power? No; instead, he would give me strength.

verses.kjv: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.
verses.decoded: There the righteous could argue with him; so I would be saved forever from my judge.

verses.kjv: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:
verses.decoded: Look, I go forward, but he is not there; I go backward, but I cannot find him.

verses.kjv: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:
verses.decoded: He works on the left side, but I cannot see him; he hides himself on the right side, so I cannot see him.

verses.kjv: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.
verses.decoded: But he knows the path I follow; when he has tested me, I will come out as pure as gold.

verses.kjv: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.
verses.decoded: My foot has followed his steps, I have kept his way, and have not turned away.

verses.kjv: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
verses.decoded: I have not turned away from the command given by his lips; I have valued the words from his mouth more than my daily food.

verses.kjv: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.
verses.decoded: But he is determined, and who can change his mind? Whatever his soul desires, that is exactly what he does.

verses.kjv: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.
verses.decoded: Because he carries out what has been planned for me, and many similar things are with him.

verses.kjv: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.
verses.decoded: That is why I am upset when I am in his presence; when I think about it, I am afraid of him.

verses.kjv: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:
verses.decoded: Because God makes my heart weak, and the Almighty causes me distress.

verses.kjv: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.
verses.decoded: Because I was not destroyed before the darkness came, and he has not hidden the darkness from my eyes.

verses.kjv: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?
verses.decoded: Why, since the Almighty is not unaware of the times, do those who do not know him fail to understand his actions?

verses.kjv: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.
verses.decoded: Some people move the boundary markers; they forcefully steal flocks and feed on them.

verses.kjv: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.
verses.decoded: They steal the donkey that belongs to the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox as a guarantee for a loan.

verses.kjv: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.
verses.decoded: They push the needy off the path; the poor people of the earth gather together in hiding.

verses.kjv: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.
verses.decoded: Look, like wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work; getting up early to hunt for food: the wilderness provides food for them and their children.

verses.kjv: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.
verses.decoded: Everyone harvests their own grain in the field, and they collect the grapes from the vineyards of the wicked.

verses.kjv: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.
verses.decoded: They force the naked to stay outside without clothes, so they have no protection from the cold.

verses.kjv: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.
verses.decoded: They get wet from the mountain rains and cling to the rocks because they have no shelter.

verses.kjv: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.
verses.decoded: They snatch the fatherless children from their mother's care and demand a pledge from the poor.

verses.kjv: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;
verses.decoded: They make him go naked without any clothes, and they take away the bundle of grain from the hungry person;

verses.kjv: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.
verses.decoded: They produce oil inside their homes, crush grapes in their winepresses, and yet experience thirst.

verses.kjv: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.
verses.decoded: People groan from inside the city, and the soul of the injured cries out: yet God does not consider their actions foolish.

verses.kjv: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.
verses.decoded: They are among those who resist the light; they do not understand its ways, nor do they stay on its paths.

verses.kjv: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.
verses.decoded: The murderer gets up at dawn and kills the poor and needy, and at night he acts like a thief.

verses.kjv: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.
verses.decoded: The eye of the adulterer also waits for the evening, saying, No one will see me; and he hides his face.

verses.kjv: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.
verses.decoded: At night they break into houses, which they had chosen for themselves during the day; they do not know the meaning of light.

verses.kjv: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.
verses.decoded: For the morning is like the shadow of death to them: if someone sees them, they are in the fear of death's shadow.

verses.kjv: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.
verses.decoded: He is as fast as flowing water; their share is cursed on the land: he does not see the path of the vineyards.

verses.kjv: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.
verses.decoded: Drought and heat dry up the snow water; similarly, the grave destroys those who have sinned.

verses.kjv: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.
verses.decoded: The mother will forget him; the worm will feed pleasantly on him; he will no longer be remembered; and wickedness will be destroyed like a tree being cut down.

verses.kjv: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.
verses.decoded: He treats the barren woman who does not have children badly and does not do good to the widow.

verses.kjv: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.
verses.decoded: He also pulls down the powerful with his strength: he stands up, and no one is certain of their life.

verses.kjv: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.
verses.decoded: Even if he is allowed to be safe and rests on that safety, his eyes are still watching their actions.

verses.kjv: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.
verses.decoded: They are lifted up for a short time, but then they disappear and are humbled; they are removed like everyone else and cut down like the heads of grain.

verses.kjv: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?
verses.decoded: And if it is not true now, who will prove me to be a liar and make my words worthless?

verses.kjv: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.decoded: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

verses.kjv: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.
verses.decoded: Power and respect belong to him; he brings peace in his heavenly places.

verses.kjv: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?
verses.decoded: Is there any count of his armies? And on whom does his light not shine?

verses.kjv: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?
verses.decoded: How then can a person be declared righteous before God? Or how can someone born of a woman be pure?

verses.kjv: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.
verses.decoded: Look, even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not clean in his eyes.

verses.kjv: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?
verses.decoded: How much less a human being, who is like a worm? And the son of man, who is like a worm?

verses.kjv: But Job answered and said,
verses.decoded: But Job replied and said,

verses.kjv: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?
verses.decoded: How have you helped the one who has no power? How do you save the arm that has no strength?

verses.kjv: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?
verses.decoded: How have you given advice to someone who has no wisdom? And how have you fully explained the matter as it really is?

verses.kjv: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?
verses.decoded: To whom have you spoken words? And whose spirit has come from you?

verses.kjv: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.decoded: Dead creatures come from beneath the waters, along with the living beings that live there.

verses.kjv: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.
verses.decoded: The realm of the dead is exposed before him, and destruction has no hiding place.

verses.kjv: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
verses.decoded: He spreads out the northern sky over empty space and hangs the earth over nothing.

verses.kjv: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.
verses.decoded: He holds the waters in his dense clouds, and the cloud does not break apart beneath them.

verses.kjv: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.
verses.decoded: He hides the brightness of his throne and spreads a cloud over it.

verses.kjv: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.
verses.decoded: He has surrounded the waters with limits, until the day and night come to an end.

verses.kjv: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.
verses.decoded: The supports of the sky shake and are amazed at his rebuke.

verses.kjv: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.
verses.decoded: He separates the sea with his power, and with his wisdom he strikes down the proud.

verses.kjv: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.
verses.decoded: By his spirit he has decorated the heavens; his hand has made the twisted serpent.

verses.kjv: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?
verses.decoded: Look, these are some of the things he does, but how little do we hear about him? Who can understand the thunder of his power?

verses.kjv: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.decoded: Furthermore, Job continued his speech and said,

verses.kjv: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;
verses.decoded: As God lives, who has taken away my right to judge, and the Almighty, who has troubled my soul;

verses.kjv: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;
verses.decoded: As long as I have breath in me and the spirit of God is in my nose,

verses.kjv: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.
verses.decoded: My lips will not speak evil, and my tongue will not tell lies.

verses.kjv: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.
verses.decoded: May it never happen that I declare you right; as long as I live, I will not give up my integrity.

verses.kjv: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
verses.decoded: I hold tightly to my righteousness and will not let it go; my heart will not accuse me as long as I live.

verses.kjv: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.
verses.decoded: Let my enemy be like the wicked, and the one who stands up against me be like the unrighteous.

verses.kjv: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?
verses.decoded: What hope does the hypocrite have, even if he has gained wealth, when God takes away his life?

verses.kjv: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?
verses.decoded: Will God listen to his cry when trouble comes to him?

verses.kjv: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?
verses.decoded: Will he find joy in the Almighty? Will he always pray to God?

verses.kjv: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
verses.decoded: I will teach you by God's power: I will not hide what belongs to the Almighty.

verses.kjv: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?
verses.decoded: Look, all of you have seen it yourselves; so why are you completely worthless like this?

verses.kjv: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.
verses.decoded: This is the share of a wicked man from God, and the inheritance of oppressors, which they will receive from the Almighty.

verses.kjv: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
verses.decoded: If his children increase in number, it will be for the sword: and his descendants will not have enough bread to be satisfied.

verses.kjv: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.
verses.decoded: Those who are left of him will be buried in death, and his widows will not cry.

verses.kjv: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;
verses.decoded: Even if he gathers silver like dust and makes clothes like clay,

verses.kjv: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
verses.decoded: He may make it ready, but the righteous will wear it, and the innocent will share the silver.

verses.kjv: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.
verses.decoded: He builds his house like a moth does, and like a temporary shelter that the guard makes.

verses.kjv: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.
verses.decoded: The rich man will lie down, but he will not be gathered; he opens his eyes, and he is gone.

verses.kjv: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.
verses.decoded: Fear grips him like floodwaters, and a storm sweeps him away during the night.

verses.kjv: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
verses.decoded: The east wind carries him away, and he leaves; and like a storm, it throws him out of his place.

verses.kjv: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.
verses.decoded: Because God will strike him and will not hold back; he would want to escape from God's hand.

verses.kjv: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
verses.decoded: People will clap their hands at him and will hiss to drive him out of his position.

verses.kjv: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.
verses.decoded: There is definitely a vein for silver, and a place where gold is found.

verses.kjv: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.
verses.decoded: Iron is extracted from the ground, and bronze is melted out of the rock.

verses.kjv: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.
verses.decoded: He brings darkness to an end and searches out all that is perfect: the dark stones and the shadow of death.

verses.kjv: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.
verses.decoded: The flood bursts out from the place where people live; even the waters that people no longer walk on are dried up and have disappeared from human reach.

verses.kjv: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.
verses.decoded: As for the earth, food comes from it; and beneath it, there is something like fire being turned over.

verses.kjv: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.
verses.decoded: Its stones are the location of sapphires, and it contains dust of gold.

verses.kjv: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture’s eye hath not seen:
verses.decoded: There is a path that no bird knows, and that the vulture’s eye has not seen:

verses.kjv: The lion’s whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.
verses.decoded: Young lions have not walked on it, and the strong lion has not gone past it.

verses.kjv: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.
verses.decoded: He reaches out his hand to the rock; he pulls up the mountains from their foundations.

verses.kjv: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.
verses.decoded: He digs out rivers through the rocks; and his eye sees every valuable thing.

verses.kjv: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.
verses.decoded: He stops the rivers from overflowing; and he brings what is hidden into the light.

verses.kjv: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.decoded: But where can wisdom be found? And where is the place of understanding?

verses.kjv: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.
verses.decoded: No one knows its value; it cannot be found among the living.

verses.kjv: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.
verses.decoded: The deep says, 'It is not in me,' and the sea says, 'It is not with me.'

verses.kjv: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.
verses.decoded: It cannot be obtained with gold, nor can silver be measured to pay its price.

verses.kjv: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.
verses.decoded: It cannot be valued with the gold from Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

verses.kjv: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.
verses.decoded: Gold and crystal cannot compare to it, and it cannot be exchanged for jewels made of pure gold.

verses.kjv: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.
verses.decoded: Coral and pearls will not be mentioned, because the value of wisdom is greater than rubies.

verses.kjv: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.
verses.decoded: The topaz from Ethiopia cannot compare to it, nor is it worth pure gold.

verses.kjv: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?
verses.decoded: Where does wisdom come from? And where is the place of understanding?

verses.kjv: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.
verses.decoded: Because it is hidden from the eyes of all living creatures, and kept secret from the birds of the sky.

verses.kjv: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.
verses.decoded: Destruction and death say, We have heard about it with our own ears.

verses.kjv: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.
verses.decoded: God understands its way, and he knows its place.

verses.kjv: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;
verses.decoded: Because he looks to the farthest parts of the earth and sees everything under the entire sky;

verses.kjv: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.
verses.decoded: He established the weight for the winds, and he measures the waters by a standard.

verses.kjv: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:
verses.decoded: When he established a rule for the rain and created a path for the lightning of the thunder:

verses.kjv: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
verses.decoded: Then he saw it and announced it; he made it ready and carefully examined it.

verses.kjv: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.
verses.decoded: And to humans he said, Look, respecting the Lord is true wisdom; and turning away from evil is understanding.

verses.kjv: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,
verses.decoded: Furthermore, Job continued his story and said,

verses.kjv: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;
verses.decoded: I wish I were like I was in the past months, like in the days when God protected me;

verses.kjv: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;
verses.decoded: When his lamp shined above my head, and when I walked through darkness by his light;

verses.kjv: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;
verses.decoded: When I was young, when God's secret was within my dwelling;

verses.kjv: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;
verses.decoded: When God was still with me, when my children were around me;

verses.kjv: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;
verses.decoded: When I cleaned my feet with butter, and the rock gave me rivers of oil;

verses.kjv: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!
verses.decoded: When I went out to the city gate, walking through the city, and when I made my place in the street!

verses.kjv: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.
verses.decoded: The young men saw me and hid themselves; the older men got up and stood.

verses.kjv: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.
verses.decoded: The leaders stopped talking and put their hand over their mouth.

verses.kjv: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.
verses.decoded: The important people were silent, and their tongues stuck to the roof of their mouths.

verses.kjv: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:
verses.decoded: When people heard me, they praised me; and when they saw me, they testified about me.

verses.kjv: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.
verses.decoded: Because I rescued the poor who cried out, the fatherless, and the person who had no one to help him.

verses.kjv: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.
verses.decoded: The blessing of the person who was about to die came to me, and I made the widow’s heart rejoice.

verses.kjv: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.
verses.decoded: I wore righteousness like clothing, and it covered me; my decisions were like a robe and a crown.

verses.kjv: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.
verses.decoded: I was eyes for the blind, and I was feet for the lame.

verses.kjv: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.
verses.decoded: I acted like a father to the poor, and I investigated cases that I did not know about.

verses.kjv: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.
verses.decoded: And I broke the jaws of the wicked and took the loot out of their teeth.

verses.kjv: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.
verses.decoded: Then I said, I will die peacefully in my home, and I will live a long life, as numerous as the grains of sand.

verses.kjv: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.
verses.decoded: My roots were extended by the waters, and the dew stayed all night on my branch.

verses.kjv: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
verses.decoded: My honor was new within me, and my strength was restored in my hand.

verses.kjv: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.
verses.decoded: People listened to me, waited patiently, and remained silent when I gave advice.

verses.kjv: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.
verses.decoded: After I spoke, they did not speak again; my words settled on them.

verses.kjv: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.
verses.decoded: And they waited for me like people wait for the rain; and they opened their mouths wide like people do for the late rain.

verses.kjv: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.
verses.decoded: If I laughed at them, they did not believe it; and they did not lower their eyes from the brightness of my face.

verses.kjv: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.
verses.decoded: I selected their path, and sat as the leader, and lived like a king in the army, like someone who comforts those who are grieving.

verses.kjv: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.
verses.decoded: But now those who are younger than I am mock me, whose fathers I would have looked down on as if they were dogs among my sheep.

verses.kjv: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?
verses.decoded: Yes, how could the strength of their hands help me, when I have lost my old age?

verses.kjv: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.
verses.decoded: Because of lack and famine, they were alone; they fled into the wilderness, which was previously deserted and empty.

verses.kjv: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.
verses.decoded: They gathered mallows near the bushes and dug up juniper roots to eat.

verses.kjv: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)
verses.decoded: They were forced out from among people, and they shouted after them like they would after a thief.

verses.kjv: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.
verses.decoded: To live in the cliffs of the valleys, in caves in the ground, and among the rocks.

verses.kjv: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.
verses.decoded: They made loud noises among the bushes; they gathered together under the nettles.

verses.kjv: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.
verses.decoded: They were the children of fools, yes, the children of worthless men; they were more despicable than the dust of the earth.

verses.kjv: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.
verses.decoded: And now I am their song, yes, I am their example of disgrace.

verses.kjv: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.
verses.decoded: They hate me, they run far away from me, and do not hesitate to spit in my face.

verses.kjv: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.
verses.decoded: Because he has loosened my rope and caused me suffering, they have also removed the bridle in front of me.

verses.kjv: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.
verses.decoded: On my right side stand the young men; they shove my feet aside, and they set up paths leading to their own ruin against me.

verses.kjv: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.
verses.decoded: They ruin my way, they bring on my disaster, and they have no one to help them.

verses.kjv: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.
verses.decoded: They attacked me like a flood breaking through a dam; in the empty wasteland, they overwhelmed me.

verses.kjv: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.
verses.decoded: Fears have come against me; they chase my life like the wind; and my well-being disappears like a cloud.

verses.kjv: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.
verses.decoded: And now my soul feels completely drained; the days of suffering have come upon me.

verses.kjv: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.
verses.decoded: My bones feel sharp pain inside me during the night, and my muscles do not get any rest.

verses.kjv: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.
verses.decoded: Because of the severe strength of my illness, my clothing has changed: it clings to me tightly like the collar of my coat.

verses.kjv: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.
verses.decoded: He has thrown me into the mud, and I have become like dust and ashes.

verses.kjv: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.
verses.decoded: I cry out to you, and you do not hear me; I stand up, and you do not pay attention to me.

verses.kjv: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.
verses.decoded: You have become cruel to me: with your strong hand you are opposing me.

verses.kjv: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.
verses.decoded: You lift me up into the wind; you make me ride on it, and you destroy my being.

verses.kjv: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.
verses.decoded: Because I know that you will bring me to death, and to the place assigned for all living.

verses.kjv: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.
verses.decoded: However, he will not reach out his hand to the grave, even if they cry out in his ruin.

verses.kjv: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?
verses.decoded: Did I not cry for the person who was in trouble? Was my heart not saddened for the poor?

verses.kjv: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.
verses.decoded: When I expected good things, bad things happened to me; and when I hoped for light, darkness came instead.

verses.kjv: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.
verses.decoded: My insides were in turmoil and did not calm down; the days of suffering kept me from rest.

verses.kjv: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.
verses.decoded: I walked around grieving before the sun rose; I stood up and cried out in the assembly.

verses.kjv: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.
verses.decoded: I am like a brother to dragons, and a friend to owls.

verses.kjv: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.
verses.decoded: My skin is dark on me, and my bones feel like they are burning with heat.

verses.kjv: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.
verses.decoded: My harp has been changed to sadness, and my musical instrument has become the sound of those who cry.

verses.kjv: I MADE a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?
verses.decoded: I made a promise to my eyes; so why should I think about a young woman?

verses.kjv: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?
verses.decoded: What part does God have from above? And what inheritance does the Almighty have from heaven?

verses.kjv: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?
verses.decoded: Is destruction not for the wicked? And is punishment not strange for those who do wrong?

verses.kjv: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?
verses.decoded: Does he not see my actions and keep track of every step I take?

verses.kjv: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;
verses.decoded: If I have lived a worthless life, or if I have rushed into dishonesty;

verses.kjv: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.
verses.decoded: Let me be measured on a fair scale, so that God may know my honesty.

verses.kjv: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;
verses.decoded: If my path has turned away from the right way, and my heart has followed after my eyes, and if any stain has stuck to my hands;

verses.kjv: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.
verses.decoded: Then let me plant seeds, and let someone else eat the crops; yes, let my descendants be destroyed.

verses.kjv: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour’s door;
verses.decoded: If my heart has been led astray by a woman, or if I have waited to trap my neighbor at his door;

verses.kjv: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.
verses.decoded: Then let my wife grind grain for someone else, and let other men lie with her.

verses.kjv: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.
verses.decoded: For this is a terrible crime; yes, it is a sin that should be punished by the judges.

verses.kjv: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.
verses.decoded: Because it is like a fire that destroys completely and would wipe out all my growth.

verses.kjv: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;
verses.decoded: If I rejected the complaint of my male servant or my female servant when they argued with me;

verses.kjv: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?
verses.decoded: What will I do when God stands up? And when he comes to see me, what will I say to him?

verses.kjv: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?
verses.decoded: Did the one who made me in the womb not also make him? Did not the same person form both of us in the womb?

verses.kjv: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;
verses.decoded: If I have refused the poor what they wanted, or made the widow sad;

verses.kjv: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;
verses.decoded: Or have I eaten my food by myself alone, without the fatherless eating any of it?

verses.kjv: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother’s womb;)
verses.decoded: Because from my youth he was raised with me like a father, and I have guided her since I was in my mother’s womb;

verses.kjv: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;
verses.decoded: If I have seen anyone die because they did not have enough clothing, or any poor person without a covering;

verses.kjv: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;
verses.decoded: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he was not warmed by the fleece of my sheep;

verses.kjv: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:
verses.decoded: If I have raised my hand to harm an orphan when I saw that my support was at the city gate:

verses.kjv: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.
verses.decoded: Then let my arm fall from my shoulder, and let my arm be broken at the bone.

verses.kjv: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
verses.decoded: Destruction from God terrified me, and because of his greatness, I could not bear it.

verses.kjv: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;
verses.decoded: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, You are my confidence;

verses.kjv: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;
verses.decoded: If I was happy because my wealth was large, and because I had gained a lot;

verses.kjv: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;
verses.decoded: If I looked at the sun when it was shining, or the moon moving in brightness;

verses.kjv: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:
verses.decoded: And my heart has been secretly tempted, or my mouth has kissed my hand:

verses.kjv: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.
verses.decoded: This would also be a sin deserving punishment by the judge, because I would have denied the God who is above.

verses.kjv: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:
verses.decoded: If I was happy when someone who hated me was destroyed, or if I felt proud when something bad happened to them:

verses.kjv: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.
verses.decoded: I have not allowed my mouth to sin by wishing harm on his life.

verses.kjv: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.
verses.decoded: If the men living in my tent did not say, 'Oh, that we could have some of his flesh! We cannot be satisfied.'

verses.kjv: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.
verses.decoded: The stranger did not sleep on the street, but I opened my doors to the traveler.

verses.kjv: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:
verses.decoded: If I hid my sins like Adam, by keeping my wrongdoing deep inside me:

verses.kjv: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?
verses.decoded: Was I afraid of a large crowd, or did the disrespect of families scare me, so that I stayed silent and did not leave the house?

verses.kjv: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.
verses.decoded: I wish someone would listen to me! Look, my desire is that God would answer me, and that my opponent had written a book.

verses.kjv: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.
verses.decoded: I would certainly carry it on my shoulder and wear it like a crown.

verses.kjv: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.
verses.decoded: I would tell him the exact number of my steps; I would approach him confidently like a prince.

verses.kjv: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;
verses.decoded: If my land cries out against me, or if its furrows also complain;

verses.kjv: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:
verses.decoded: If I have eaten the fruits of it without paying, or have caused the owners to lose their lives:

verses.kjv: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.
verses.decoded: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and weeds instead of barley. The words of Job are finished.

verses.kjv: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
verses.decoded: So these three men stopped answering Job because he thought he was righteous.

verses.kjv: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.
verses.decoded: Then the anger of Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, from the family of Ram, was aroused; his anger was directed at Job because Job claimed to be right instead of God.

verses.kjv: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
verses.decoded: His anger was also aroused against his three friends because they could not find an answer, yet they had condemned Job.

verses.kjv: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.
verses.decoded: Now Elihu had waited until Job had spoken, because they were older than he was.

verses.kjv: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.
verses.decoded: When Elihu saw that these three men had no answer, his anger was aroused.

verses.kjv: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.
verses.decoded: And Elihu, the son of Barachel the Buzite, answered and said, I am young, and you are very old; therefore I was afraid and did not dare to share my opinion with you.

verses.kjv: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.
verses.decoded: I said, Time should speak, and many years should teach wisdom.

verses.kjv: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verses.decoded: But there is a spirit in a person, and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.

verses.kjv: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.
verses.decoded: Important people are not always wise, and older people do not always understand what is right.

verses.kjv: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.decoded: Therefore I said, Listen to me; I will also share my opinion.

verses.kjv: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.
verses.decoded: Look, I waited for your words; I listened carefully to your explanations while you tried to find what to say.
