verses.kjv: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:
verses.decoded: Yes, I listened to you, and there was no one among you who convinced Job or responded to what he said.

verses.kjv: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.
verses.decoded: So that you do not say, We have discovered wisdom: God brings him down, not a human.

verses.kjv: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.
verses.decoded: Now he has not spoken against me, and I will not respond to him with your words.

verses.kjv: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.
verses.decoded: They were surprised, they did not answer anymore: they stopped speaking.

verses.kjv: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)
verses.decoded: When I had waited, because they did not speak but stood silently and said nothing more;

verses.kjv: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.
verses.decoded: I said, I will also give my answer; I will also share my opinion.

verses.kjv: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.
verses.decoded: Because I am full of words, the spirit inside me forces me.

verses.kjv: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.
verses.decoded: Look, my stomach is like wine that has no way to escape; it is about to burst like new bottles.

verses.kjv: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.
verses.decoded: I will speak so that I may feel better: I will open my mouth and respond.

verses.kjv: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man’s person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.
verses.decoded: Please do not let me show favoritism to anyone, and do not let me give flattering titles to people.

verses.kjv: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.
verses.decoded: Because I do not know how to give flattering titles; if I did, my creator would quickly remove me.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
verses.decoded: Therefore, Job, I ask you, listen to what I say, and pay attention to all my words.

verses.kjv: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
verses.decoded: Look, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue has spoken inside my mouth.

verses.kjv: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
verses.decoded: My words will come from the honesty of my heart, and my lips will clearly speak knowledge.

verses.kjv: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
verses.decoded: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty has given me life.

verses.kjv: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
verses.decoded: If you can answer me, arrange your words clearly before me, stand up.

verses.kjv: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
verses.decoded: Look, I am here as you want, representing God: I was also made from the dust.

verses.kjv: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
verses.decoded: Look, my threat will not make you afraid, and my hand will not be heavy on you.

verses.kjv: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,
verses.decoded: Surely you have spoken in my hearing, and I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

verses.kjv: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.
verses.decoded: I am pure and have not sinned, I am innocent; there is no wrongdoing in me.

verses.kjv: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
verses.decoded: Look, he finds reasons to accuse me, he considers me his enemy,

verses.kjv: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
verses.decoded: He places my feet in restraints, he observes all my ways.

verses.kjv: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
verses.decoded: Look, in this you are not right: I will respond to you, that God is greater than man.

verses.kjv: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.
verses.decoded: Why do you argue against him? Because he does not have to explain any of his actions.

verses.kjv: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.
verses.decoded: For God speaks once, yes twice, but people do not understand it.

verses.kjv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
verses.decoded: In a dream, in a vision during the night, when deep sleep comes over people, while they are lying in bed;

verses.kjv: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
verses.decoded: Then he opens the ears of people and confirms their instruction,

verses.kjv: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
verses.decoded: So that he may turn a person away from their plan and keep pride hidden from them.

verses.kjv: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.decoded: He saves his life from the grave and protects his life from being killed by the sword.

verses.kjv: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:
verses.decoded: He is also disciplined with pain while lying in his bed, and his many bones suffer intense pain.

verses.kjv: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
verses.decoded: So that his life hates food, and his soul refuses fine meals.

verses.kjv: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.
verses.decoded: His flesh wastes away so that it cannot be seen, and his bones that were hidden become visible.

verses.kjv: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
verses.decoded: Yes, his soul comes close to death, and his life approaches those who bring destruction.

verses.kjv: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
verses.decoded: If there is a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show a person their righteousness:

verses.kjv: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
verses.decoded: Then God is kind to him and says, Save him from going down to the grave; I have found a way to pay the price.

verses.kjv: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:
verses.decoded: His body will be healthier than a child's; he will go back to the days of his youth.

verses.kjv: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
verses.decoded: He will pray to God, and God will be kind to him; he will see God's face with happiness because God will give a person what is right.

verses.kjv: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;
verses.decoded: He looks at people, and if anyone says, I have sinned and twisted what was right, and it did not benefit me;

verses.kjv: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
verses.decoded: He will save his life from going down into the grave, and he will live to see the light.

verses.kjv: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,
verses.decoded: Look, God often does all these things with people,

verses.kjv: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.decoded: To rescue his life from death, to be illuminated by the light of the living.

verses.kjv: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully, Job, pay attention to me: be silent, and I will speak.

verses.kjv: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
verses.decoded: If you have anything to say, answer me: speak, because I want to defend you.

verses.kjv: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
verses.decoded: If not, listen to me: be quiet, and I will teach you wisdom.

verses.kjv: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,
verses.decoded: Also, Elihu replied and said,

verses.kjv: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.
verses.decoded: Listen to my words, you wise men; and pay attention to me, you who have knowledge.

verses.kjv: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
verses.decoded: Because the ear tests words, just as the mouth tastes food.

verses.kjv: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.
verses.decoded: Let us decide what is right for us; let us understand among ourselves what is good.

verses.kjv: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.
verses.decoded: Because Job has said, 'I am innocent,' and 'God has taken away my right to judge.'

verses.kjv: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.
verses.decoded: Should I speak falsely about what is right? My injury cannot be healed without wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?
verses.decoded: Who is a man like Job, who accepts insults as easily as drinking water?

verses.kjv: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.
verses.decoded: Who associates with those who do wrong and spends time with evil people.

verses.kjv: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.
verses.decoded: Because he has said, It does not benefit a person at all to find joy in God.

verses.kjv: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.
verses.decoded: So listen to me, you people who have understanding: it is impossible for God to do evil, and for the Almighty to commit wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.
verses.decoded: He will give a person what they deserve for their actions and make sure everyone experiences consequences based on their behavior.

verses.kjv: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.
verses.decoded: Yes, certainly God will not act wickedly, and the Almighty will not twist justice.

verses.kjv: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?
verses.decoded: Who has given him authority over the earth? Or who has arranged the entire world?

verses.kjv: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;
verses.decoded: If God focuses his attention on a person, if he takes back to himself that person's spirit and breath;

verses.kjv: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.
verses.decoded: All living beings will die together, and humans will return to dust.

verses.kjv: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.
verses.decoded: If you now have understanding, listen to this: pay attention to the words I am saying.

verses.kjv: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?
verses.decoded: Will someone who hates what is right be allowed to govern? And will you condemn the one who is perfectly just?

verses.kjv: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?
verses.decoded: Is it appropriate to say to a king, You are wicked? and to rulers, You are ungodly?

verses.kjv: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.
verses.decoded: How much less to the one who does not show favoritism to princes, nor values the rich more than the poor? For they are all the work of his hands.

verses.kjv: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.
verses.decoded: They will die suddenly, and the people will be shaken at midnight and disappear; the powerful will be removed without human intervention.

verses.kjv: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.
verses.decoded: Because his eyes are on the paths of people, and he watches all their steps.

verses.kjv: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.
verses.decoded: There is no darkness or shadow of death where those who do wrong can hide themselves.

verses.kjv: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.
verses.decoded: Because God will not place on a person more than what is right, so that they would have to stand in judgment before God.

verses.kjv: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.
verses.decoded: He will destroy countless strong men and put others in their place.

verses.kjv: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.
verses.decoded: That is why he knows what they do, and he brings them down during the night, causing them to be destroyed.

verses.kjv: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;
verses.decoded: He strikes them down like wicked people in front of everyone;

verses.kjv: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:
verses.decoded: Because they turned away from him and refused to think about any of his ways:

verses.kjv: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.
verses.decoded: So that they bring the cry of the poor to him, and he listens to the cry of those who are suffering.

verses.kjv: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:
verses.decoded: When he gives peace, who can cause trouble? And when he hides his face, who can see him? Whether it is done against a nation or against just one person:

verses.kjv: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.
verses.decoded: So that the hypocrite does not rule, to prevent the people from being trapped.

verses.kjv: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:
verses.decoded: It is certainly appropriate to say to God, I have accepted discipline, I will not sin again.

verses.kjv: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.
verses.decoded: Teach me what I do not see: if I have done wrong, I will not do it again.

verses.kjv: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.
verses.decoded: Should it be according to your mind? He will repay it, whether you refuse or whether you choose; not I. So speak what you know.

verses.kjv: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.
verses.decoded: Let intelligent people explain to me, and let a wise person listen to me.

verses.kjv: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.
verses.decoded: Job has spoken without understanding, and his words were without wisdom.

verses.kjv: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.
verses.decoded: I want Job to be tested completely because of his defenses of wicked people.

verses.kjv: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.
verses.decoded: Because he adds rebellion to his sin, he claps his hands among us and increases his words against God.

verses.kjv: Elihu spake moreover, and said,
verses.decoded: Elihu continued speaking and said,

verses.kjv: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God’s?
verses.decoded: Do you think this is right, that you said, My righteousness is greater than God’s?

verses.kjv: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?
verses.decoded: Because you said, What benefit will it be to you? And, What will I gain if I am forgiven for my sin?

verses.kjv: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.
verses.decoded: I will answer you and your companions with you.

verses.kjv: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.
verses.decoded: Look at the sky and see; notice the clouds that are higher than you.

verses.kjv: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?
verses.decoded: If you sin, what do you do against him? Or if your sins increase, what do you do to him?

verses.kjv: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?
verses.decoded: If you are righteous, what do you give to him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

verses.kjv: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.
verses.decoded: Your wickedness can harm a person like you; and your righteousness can benefit a human being.

verses.kjv: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.
verses.decoded: Because of the many oppressions, the oppressed cry out; they cry out because of the power of the mighty.

verses.kjv: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;
verses.decoded: But no one says, Where is God my creator, who gives songs in the night;

verses.kjv: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?
verses.decoded: Who teaches us more than the animals of the earth and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?

verses.kjv: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.
verses.decoded: They cry out there, but no one answers because of the arrogance of evil people.

verses.kjv: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.
verses.decoded: Surely God will not listen to meaningless words, and the Almighty will not pay attention to them.

verses.kjv: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.
verses.decoded: Even though you say you will not see him, judgment is in front of him; so trust in him.

verses.kjv: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:
verses.decoded: But now, since it is not like that, God has punished him in his anger; yet he does not realize it in a serious way.

verses.kjv: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.
verses.decoded: That is why Job speaks without purpose; he says many things without understanding.

verses.kjv: Elihu also proceeded, and said,
verses.decoded: Elihu continued and said,

verses.kjv: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God’s behalf.
verses.decoded: Allow me a little time, and I will show you that I still have things to say for God.

verses.kjv: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
verses.decoded: I will get my understanding from far away, and I will give credit for righteousness to my Creator.

verses.kjv: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.
verses.decoded: Because truly my words will not be false: the one who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

verses.kjv: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
verses.decoded: Look, God is powerful and does not look down on anyone; He is powerful in strength and wisdom.

verses.kjv: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.
verses.decoded: He does not keep the life of the wicked safe, but gives justice to the poor.

verses.kjv: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.
verses.decoded: He does not take his eyes off the righteous; they are with kings on the throne; yes, he establishes them forever, and they are honored.

verses.kjv: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;
verses.decoded: And if they are bound with chains and held fast by ropes of suffering;

verses.kjv: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.
verses.decoded: Then he shows them their actions and the sins they have gone beyond.

verses.kjv: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.
verses.decoded: He also opens their ears to instruction and commands them to turn away from sin.

verses.kjv: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.
verses.decoded: If they obey and serve him, they will live their lives in success, and their years in happiness.

verses.kjv: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.
verses.decoded: But if they do not obey, they will be destroyed by the sword, and they will die without understanding.

verses.kjv: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.
verses.decoded: But those who are hypocritical in their hearts store up anger; they do not cry out when God binds them.

verses.kjv: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.
verses.decoded: They die young, and their life is among the impure.

verses.kjv: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.
verses.decoded: He rescues the poor when they are suffering and makes them listen when they are oppressed.

verses.kjv: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.
verses.decoded: In the same way, he would have taken you out of the narrow place into a wide place, where there is no restriction; and what is set on your table would be rich and abundant.

verses.kjv: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.
verses.decoded: But you have experienced the punishment meant for the wicked: punishment and fairness have come upon you.

verses.kjv: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.
verses.decoded: Because there is anger, be careful that he does not take you away with his blow; then no large payment can save you.

verses.kjv: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.
verses.decoded: Will he value your wealth? No, not gold, nor all the power you have.

verses.kjv: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.
verses.decoded: Do not long for the night when people are killed in their homes.

verses.kjv: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.
verses.decoded: Be careful, do not ignore wrongdoing: because you have chosen this instead of suffering.

verses.kjv: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?
verses.decoded: Look, God raises people up by his power: who teaches like him?

verses.kjv: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?
verses.decoded: Who has commanded him how to act? Or who can say, You have done wrong?

verses.kjv: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.
verses.decoded: Remember that you praise his work, which people see.

verses.kjv: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.
verses.decoded: Everyone can see it; people can observe it from a distance.

verses.kjv: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.
verses.decoded: Look, God is great, and we do not know him, nor can anyone discover the number of his years.

verses.kjv: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:
verses.decoded: Because he makes the drops of water small; they fall as rain according to the amount of vapor.

verses.kjv: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.
verses.decoded: Which the clouds pour down and drip upon people in great amounts.

verses.kjv: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?
verses.decoded: Can anyone understand how the clouds spread out, or the sound of his dwelling place?

verses.kjv: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.
verses.decoded: Look, he spreads his light over it and covers the bottom of the sea.

verses.kjv: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.
verses.decoded: Because he judges the people by them; he provides food in abundance.

verses.kjv: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.
verses.decoded: He covers the light with clouds and commands it not to shine because of the cloud that comes between.

verses.kjv: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
verses.decoded: The sound of it announces its presence, and the animals also respond to the mist.

verses.kjv: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.
verses.decoded: Because of this, my heart also trembles and moves from its place.

verses.kjv: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully to the sound of his voice and the noise that comes from his mouth.

verses.kjv: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.
verses.decoded: He controls it across the entire sky, and his lightning reaches to the farthest parts of the earth.

verses.kjv: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.
verses.decoded: After that, a voice roars: he thunders with the voice of his greatness; and he will not stop them when his voice is heard.

verses.kjv: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.
verses.decoded: God thunders wonderfully with his voice; he does great things that we cannot understand.

verses.kjv: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.
verses.decoded: For he commands the snow to fall on the earth; similarly, he commands the light rain and the heavy rain that comes from his power.

verses.kjv: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
verses.decoded: He closes the hand of every person so that everyone may recognize his work.

verses.kjv: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.
verses.decoded: Then the animals go into their shelters and stay in their places.

verses.kjv: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.
verses.decoded: The whirlwind comes from the south, and cold weather comes from the north.

verses.kjv: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.
verses.decoded: Frost is created by the breath of God, and the surface of the waters is narrowed.

verses.kjv: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:
verses.decoded: Also, by raining, he makes the thick cloud tired; he scatters his bright cloud.

verses.kjv: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.
verses.decoded: And it is directed by his plans so that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the earth.

verses.kjv: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.
verses.decoded: He makes it happen, whether for discipline, for his land, or for mercy.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.
verses.decoded: Listen to this, Job: stop and think about the amazing works of God.

verses.kjv: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?
verses.decoded: Do you know when God arranged them and made the light of his cloud shine?

verses.kjv: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?
verses.decoded: Do you understand how the clouds are balanced, the amazing works of the one who is perfect in knowledge?

verses.kjv: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?
verses.decoded: How your clothes are warm when he calms the earth with the south wind?

verses.kjv: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?
verses.decoded: Have you spread out the sky with him, which is strong and looks like a molten mirror?

verses.kjv: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.
verses.decoded: Teach us what we should say to him, because we cannot arrange our words properly in the midst of confusion.

verses.kjv: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.
verses.decoded: Should it be told to him that I am speaking? If a man speaks, he will certainly be overwhelmed.

verses.kjv: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.
verses.decoded: And now people do not see the bright light that is in the clouds, but the wind passes by and cleanses them.

verses.kjv: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.
verses.decoded: Good weather comes from the north; with God is awesome greatness.

verses.kjv: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.
verses.decoded: When it comes to the Almighty, we cannot fully understand him: he is excellent in power, in judgment, and in abundant justice; he will not harm.

verses.kjv: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.
verses.decoded: People therefore fear him; he does not show favor to anyone who is wise in their own understanding.

verses.kjv: Then the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD answered Job from the whirlwind and said,

verses.kjv: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?
verses.decoded: Who is this person that confuses advice with words that show no understanding?

verses.kjv: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.
verses.decoded: Prepare yourself like a man; because I will question you, and you will answer me.

verses.kjv: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verses.decoded: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell me, if you understand.

verses.kjv: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?
verses.decoded: Who has set its dimensions, if you know? Or who has stretched a measuring line across it?

verses.kjv: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;
verses.decoded: On what are its foundations secured? Who laid its cornerstone?

verses.kjv: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
verses.decoded: When the morning stars sang together, and all the angels shouted for joy?

verses.kjv: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?
verses.decoded: Or who closed the sea with gates when it burst out, as if it had come out of the womb?

verses.kjv: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,
verses.decoded: When I made the cloud its clothing, and thick darkness its wrapping,

verses.kjv: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,
verses.decoded: And I broke open the place I had assigned for it, and set bars and doors,

verses.kjv: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?
verses.decoded: And said, You will come this far, but no further; here your proud waves will stop.

verses.kjv: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;
verses.decoded: Have you commanded the morning since your existence began, and told the dawn where it should appear?

verses.kjv: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?
verses.decoded: So that it could reach the farthest parts of the earth, to shake the wicked out of it?

verses.kjv: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.
verses.decoded: It becomes like clay pressed into a seal; and it stays firm like a garment.

verses.kjv: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.
verses.decoded: And their light is taken away from the wicked, and the strong arm will be broken.

verses.kjv: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?
verses.decoded: Have you gone into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked to explore the depths?

verses.kjv: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?
verses.decoded: Have the gates of death been opened to you? Or have you seen the doors of the shadow of death?

verses.kjv: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.
verses.decoded: Have you understood the width of the earth? Tell me if you know everything about it.

verses.kjv: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,
verses.decoded: Where is the path where light lives? And as for darkness, where is its place?

verses.kjv: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?
verses.decoded: So that you would bring it to its limit, and you would know the paths to its home?

verses.kjv: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?
verses.decoded: Do you know it because you were born then? Or because your life has been very long?

verses.kjv: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,
verses.decoded: Have you entered into the storehouses of the snow? Or have you seen the storehouses of the hail?

verses.kjv: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
verses.decoded: Which I have kept for the time of trouble, for the day of battle and war?

verses.kjv: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?
verses.decoded: How is the light separated that spreads the east wind across the earth?

verses.kjv: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;
verses.decoded: Who has set a path for the overflowing waters, or a route for the lightning of thunder?

verses.kjv: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;
verses.decoded: To make it rain on the earth where no person lives; on the wilderness where there is no one;

verses.kjv: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?
verses.decoded: To satisfy the empty and barren land, and to make the bud of the young plant grow?

verses.kjv: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?
verses.decoded: Does the rain have a father? Or who has caused the drops of dew to exist?

verses.kjv: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?
verses.decoded: From whose womb did the ice come? And who gave birth to the white frost of heaven?

verses.kjv: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.
verses.decoded: The waters are hidden as if covered by a stone, and the surface of the deep is frozen.

verses.kjv: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?
verses.decoded: Can you tie up the gentle powers of the Pleiades, or untie the ropes of Orion?

verses.kjv: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?
verses.decoded: Can you bring out the Mazzaroth at its proper time? Or can you guide Arcturus and its children?

verses.kjv: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?
verses.decoded: Do you understand the laws of the heavens? Can you establish their authority over the earth?

verses.kjv: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?
verses.decoded: Can you raise your voice to the clouds so that a large amount of water may cover you?

verses.kjv: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?
verses.decoded: Can you send lightning so that it goes and says to you, Here we are?

verses.kjv: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?
verses.decoded: Who has placed wisdom inside the inner being? Or who has given understanding to the heart?

verses.kjv: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,
verses.decoded: Who can count the clouds with understanding? Or who can hold back the storehouses of heaven?

verses.kjv: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?
verses.decoded: When the dust becomes hard, and the clumps stick firmly together?

verses.kjv: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,
verses.decoded: Will you hunt the prey for the lion? Or satisfy the hunger of the young lions?

verses.kjv: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?
verses.decoded: When they lie down in their dens and stay hidden in their shelters to wait in ambush?

verses.kjv: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
verses.decoded: Who provides food for the raven? When its young cry out to God, they wander because they have no food.

verses.kjv: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
verses.decoded: Do you know the time when the wild goats of the rock give birth? Or can you notice when the female deer have their babies?

verses.kjv: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
verses.decoded: Can you count the months they complete? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

verses.kjv: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
verses.decoded: They lower their bodies, they give birth to their young, they push out their pains.

verses.kjv: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
verses.decoded: Their young ones are well cared for, they grow up eating grain; they leave and do not come back to them.

verses.kjv: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
verses.decoded: Who has set the wild donkey free? Who has untied the ropes of the wild donkey?

verses.kjv: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
verses.decoded: I have made the wilderness his home, and the empty land his place to live.

verses.kjv: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
verses.decoded: It ignores the large crowds in the city and does not pay attention to the driver's shouting.

verses.kjv: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
verses.decoded: The mountain ranges are his grazing land, and he looks for every green plant.

verses.kjv: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
verses.decoded: Will the unicorn be willing to serve you, or stay near your feeding trough?

verses.kjv: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
verses.decoded: Can you tie the unicorn with a rope in the furrow? Or will he plow the valleys after you?

verses.kjv: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
verses.decoded: Will you trust him because his strength is great? Or will you leave your work to him?

verses.kjv: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?
verses.decoded: Will you trust him to bring your offspring home and gather them into your barn?

verses.kjv: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
verses.decoded: Did you give the beautiful wings to the peacocks? Or wings and feathers to the ostrich?

verses.kjv: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
verses.decoded: She leaves her eggs on the ground and keeps them warm in the dirt,

verses.kjv: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
verses.decoded: And forgets that a foot might crush them, or that a wild animal might tear them apart.

verses.kjv: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
verses.decoded: She is tough toward her young ones, as if they were not hers; her effort is useless and without worry;

verses.kjv: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
verses.decoded: Because God has taken away her wisdom, and he has not given her understanding.

verses.kjv: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
verses.decoded: When she raises herself up high, she looks down on the horse and its rider.

verses.kjv: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
verses.decoded: Have you given the horse its strength? Have you covered its neck with thunder?

verses.kjv: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.
verses.decoded: Can you make him afraid like a grasshopper? The proud flare of his nostrils is terrifying.

verses.kjv: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
verses.decoded: He digs with his feet in the valley and is happy because of his strength; he goes out to face the soldiers.

verses.kjv: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
verses.decoded: He laughs at fear and is not scared; he does not run away from the sword.

verses.kjv: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
verses.decoded: The quiver rattles against him, the shining spear and the shield.

verses.kjv: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that it is the sound of the trumpet.
verses.decoded: He swallows the ground with fierceness and anger; he does not believe that it is the sound of the trumpet.

verses.kjv: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
verses.decoded: He shouts among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he senses the battle from far away, the roar of the commanders, and the shouting.

verses.kjv: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, and stretch her wings toward the south?
verses.decoded: Does the hawk fly by your understanding and spread its wings toward the south?

verses.kjv: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
verses.decoded: Does the eagle fly up at your command and build her nest on high?

verses.kjv: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
verses.decoded: She lives and stays on the rock, on the cliff of the rock, and the secure place.

verses.kjv: From thence she seeketh the prey, and her eyes behold afar off.
verses.decoded: From there she looks for the prey, and her eyes see it from far away.

verses.kjv: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain are, there is she.
verses.decoded: Her young ones also drink blood, and wherever there are dead bodies, she is there.

verses.kjv: Moreover the Lord answered Job, and said,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD answered Job and said,

verses.kjv: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
verses.decoded: Can the one who argues with the Almighty teach him? Let the one who criticizes God answer for it.

verses.kjv: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
verses.decoded: Then Job answered the LORD and said,

verses.kjv: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
verses.decoded: Look, I am worthless; what can I say to you? I will put my hand over my mouth.

verses.kjv: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
verses.decoded: I have spoken once, but I will not answer again; yes, twice, but I will say no more.

verses.kjv: Then answered the Lord unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD answered Job from the whirlwind and said,

verses.kjv: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.decoded: Prepare yourself now like a man: I will ask you questions, and you will tell me the answers.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
verses.decoded: Will you also cancel my judgment? Will you condemn me so that you can be considered right?

verses.kjv: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
verses.decoded: Do you have an arm like God? Can you shout with a voice like his?

verses.kjv: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
verses.decoded: Dress yourself now with majesty and excellence; and clothe yourself with glory and beauty.

verses.kjv: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one that is proud, and abase him.
verses.decoded: Let your anger be fully expressed, and look at everyone who is proud and humble them.

verses.kjv: Look on every one that is proud, and bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
verses.decoded: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble them; and crush the wicked where they stand.

verses.kjv: Hide them in the dust together; and bind their faces in secret.
verses.decoded: Cover them together in the dust; and hide their faces in a secret place.

verses.kjv: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
verses.decoded: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

verses.kjv: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
verses.decoded: Look now at behemoth, which I created along with you; it eats grass like an ox.

verses.kjv: Lo now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly.
verses.decoded: Look now, his strength is in his lower back, and his power is in the center of his abdomen.

verses.kjv: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
verses.decoded: He moves his tail like a cedar tree: the muscles of his thighs are tightly connected.

verses.kjv: His bones are as strong pieces of brass; his bones are like bars of iron.
verses.decoded: His bones are like strong pieces of bronze; his bones are like iron bars.

verses.kjv: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him.
verses.decoded: He is the greatest of all that God has made; the one who created him can make his sword come near him.

verses.kjv: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
verses.decoded: The mountains definitely provide him with food, where all the wild animals play.

verses.kjv: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
verses.decoded: He lies down under the shady trees, hidden among the reeds and marshes.

verses.kjv: The shady trees cover him with their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
verses.decoded: The leafy trees cover him with their shade; the willow trees by the stream surround him.

verses.kjv: Behold, he drinketh up a river, and hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
verses.decoded: Look, he drinks up a river without rushing; he believes he can take the Jordan River into his mouth.

verses.kjv: He taketh it with his eyes: his nose pierceth through snares.
verses.decoded: He sees it with his eyes; his nose goes through traps.

verses.kjv: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
verses.decoded: Can you pull Leviathan out with a hook? Or catch his tongue with a rope that you lower down?

verses.kjv: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
verses.decoded: Can you put a hook into his nose? Or pierce his jaw with a thorn?

verses.kjv: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
verses.decoded: Will he make many requests to you? Will he speak gentle words to you?

verses.kjv: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
verses.decoded: Will he make a promise with you? Will you take him as a servant forever?

verses.kjv: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
verses.decoded: Will you play with him like you play with a bird? Or will you tie him up for your young women?

verses.kjv: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
verses.decoded: Will his friends prepare a feast with him? Will they divide him up among the traders?

verses.kjv: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
verses.decoded: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons? Or his head with fish spears?

verses.kjv: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
verses.decoded: Put your hand on him, remember the fight, and do no more.

verses.kjv: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.decoded: Look, his hope is useless: will anyone not be terrified just by seeing him?

verses.kjv: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
verses.decoded: No one is so fierce that they dare to provoke him: who then can stand in front of me?

verses.kjv: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.decoded: Who has stopped me so that I should pay him back? Everything under the entire sky belongs to me.

verses.kjv: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
verses.decoded: I will not hide his features, nor his strength, nor his beautiful form.

verses.kjv: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
verses.decoded: Who can uncover the surface of his skin? Or who can approach him with a double bridle?

verses.kjv: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
verses.decoded: Who can open the jaws of his mouth? His teeth are frightening all around.

verses.kjv: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
verses.decoded: His scales are his pride, tightly closed together like a secure seal.

verses.kjv: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.decoded: One is so close to the other that no air can come between them.

verses.kjv: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.decoded: They are connected to each other, they cling together, so they cannot be separated.

verses.kjv: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.decoded: When he sneezes, light shines out, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

verses.kjv: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
verses.decoded: Burning lamps come out of his mouth, and sparks of fire jump out.

verses.kjv: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
verses.decoded: Smoke comes out of his nostrils, like steam from a boiling pot or cauldron.

verses.kjv: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
verses.decoded: His breath lights coals on fire, and a flame comes out of his mouth.

verses.kjv: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
verses.decoded: Strength stays in his neck, and sadness turns into happiness when he is present.

verses.kjv: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
verses.decoded: The scales of his flesh are joined tightly together; they are solid and cannot be separated.

verses.kjv: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
verses.decoded: His heart is as solid as a stone; yes, as hard as a piece of the lower millstone.

verses.kjv: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
verses.decoded: When he lifts himself up, the powerful are afraid; because of his violent actions, they cleanse themselves.

verses.kjv: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
verses.decoded: The sword of the one who attacks him cannot hold him back: neither the spear, the dart, nor the coat of mail.

verses.kjv: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
verses.decoded: He considers iron to be like straw, and bronze to be like decayed wood.

verses.kjv: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
verses.decoded: An arrow cannot make him run away; stones from a sling become like straw when they hit him.

verses.kjv: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
verses.decoded: Darts are considered like dry grass: he laughs at the shaking of a spear.

verses.kjv: Sharp stones are under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
verses.decoded: Sharp stones are beneath him; he spreads sharp pointed objects on the mud.

verses.kjv: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.decoded: He causes the deep water to boil like a pot; he makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

verses.kjv: He maketh a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
verses.decoded: He creates a shining path behind him; it looks like the deep waters are white with foam.

verses.kjv: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
verses.decoded: There is no one like him on earth, who is made without fear.

verses.kjv: He beholdeth all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
verses.decoded: He looks at all things that are high: he is a ruler over all proud people.

verses.kjv: Then Job answered the Lord, and said,
verses.decoded: Then Job answered the LORD and said,

verses.kjv: I know that thou canst do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from thee.
verses.decoded: I know that you can do everything, and that no thought can be hidden from you.

verses.kjv: Who is he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
verses.decoded: Who is the person who keeps advice hidden without understanding? That is why I have spoken about things I did not understand; things too amazing for me, which I did not know.

verses.kjv: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
verses.decoded: Listen, I ask you, and I will speak: I will question you, and you tell me.

verses.kjv: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
verses.decoded: I have heard about you by listening with my ears, but now my eyes see you.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
verses.decoded: Therefore I hate myself and am sorry while sitting in dust and ashes.

verses.kjv: And it was so, that after the Lord had spoken these words unto Job, the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job hath.
verses.decoded: And it happened that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, "I am angry with you and your two friends because you have not spoken correctly about me, as my servant Job has."

verses.kjv: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that ye have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
verses.decoded: So now take seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job. Offer a burnt offering for yourselves, and my servant Job will pray for you. I will accept his prayer, so that I will not deal with you according to your foolishness, because you have not spoken the truth about me like my servant Job has.

verses.kjv: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the Lord commanded them: the Lord also accepted Job.
verses.decoded: So Eliphaz from Teman, Bildad from Shuah, and Zophar from Naamath went and did exactly as the LORD commanded them. The LORD also accepted Job.

verses.kjv: And the Lord turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.decoded: The LORD changed Job's situation when he prayed for his friends. The LORD also gave Job twice as much as he had before.

verses.kjv: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the Lord had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
verses.decoded: Then all his brothers and all his sisters and everyone who had known him before and had shared meals with him in his house came to him. They mourned with him and comforted him for all the suffering that the LORD had caused him. Each person also gave him a sum of money and each one a gold earring.

verses.kjv: So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
verses.decoded: So the LORD blessed the later part of Job's life more than the beginning, because he owned fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand pairs of oxen, and one thousand female donkeys.

verses.kjv: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.decoded: He also had seven sons and three daughters.

verses.kjv: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
verses.decoded: He named the first Jemima, the second Kezia, and the third Keren-happuch.

verses.kjv: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
verses.decoded: And in the whole land, no women were found as beautiful as the daughters of Job; and their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.

verses.kjv: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, even four generations.
verses.decoded: After this, Job lived for one hundred and forty years, and he saw his children, his grandchildren, even four generations.

verses.kjv: So Job died, being old and full of days. THE
verses.decoded: So Job died, being old and having lived a full life.
